name: C_PurchaseOrderFs
description: Purchase Order Overview (Header + Item + Material + Plant)
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "CPURCHASEORDFS" AS SELECT
            ekko.MANDT AS Client,
            ekko.EBELN AS PurchaseOrder,
            ekko.BUKRS AS CompanyCode,
            ekko.BSTYP AS PurchasingDocumentCategory,
            ekko.BSART AS PurchasingDocumentType,
            ekko.STATU AS PurchasingDocumentStatus,
            ekko.AEDAT AS CreationDate,
            ekko.ERNAM AS CreatedByUser,
            ekko.LIFNR AS Supplier,
            ekko.WAERS AS Currency,
            ekpo.EBELP AS PurchaseOrderItem,
            ekpo.TXZ01 AS PurchaseOrderItemText,
            ekpo.MATNR AS Material,
            ekpo.WERKS AS Plant,
            ekpo.LGORT AS StorageLocation,
            ekpo.MENGE AS OrderQuantity,
            ekpo.MEINS AS PurchaseOrderQuantityUnit,
            ekpo.NETPR AS NetPriceAmount,
            ekpo.NETWR AS NetAmount,
            mara.MTART AS MaterialType,
            mara.MATKL AS MaterialGroup,
            t001w.NAME1 AS PlantName,
            t001w.BWKEY AS ValuationArea,
            t001w.FABKL AS FactoryCalendar
        FROM "EKKO" ekko
        INNER JOIN "EKPO" ekpo ON ekko.MANDT = ekpo.MANDT AND ekko.EBELN = ekpo.EBELN
        LEFT OUTER JOIN "MARA" mara ON ekpo.MANDT = mara.MANDT AND ekpo.MATNR = mara.MATNR
        LEFT OUTER JOIN "T001W" t001w ON ekpo.MANDT = t001w.MANDT AND ekpo.WERKS = t001w.WERKS

name: I_SalesDocumentItem
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "ISALESDOCITEM" AS SELECT
            vbap.MANDT AS Client,
            vbap.VBELN AS SalesDocument,
            vbap.POSNR AS SalesDocumentItem,
            vbap.MATNR AS Material,
            vbap.MATKL AS MaterialGroup,
            vbap.KWMENG AS OrderQuantity,
            vbap.VRKME AS SalesUnit,
            vbap.NETWR AS NetAmount,
            vbap.WAERK AS TransactionCurrency,
            vbak.VKORG AS SalesOrganization,
            vbak.VTWEG AS DistributionChannel,
            vbak.SPART AS Division,
            vbak.KUNNR AS SoldToParty,
            kna1.NAME1 AS CustomerName,
            kna1.LAND1 AS CountryKey,
            kna1.ORT01 AS City
        FROM "VBAP" vbap
        INNER JOIN "VBAK" vbak ON vbap.MANDT = vbak.MANDT AND vbap.VBELN = vbak.VBELN
        LEFT OUTER JOIN "KNA1" kna1 ON vbak.MANDT = kna1.MANDT AND vbak.KUNNR = kna1.KUNNR

name: I_ProfitCenter
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "IPROFITCENTER" AS SELECT
            cepc.MANDT AS Client,
            cepc.PRCTR AS ProfitCenter,
            cepc.KOKRS AS ControllingArea,
            cepc.SEGMENT AS Segment,
            cepct.KTEXT AS ProfitCenterName
        FROM "CEPC" cepc
        LEFT OUTER JOIN "CEPCT" cepct ON cepc.MANDT = cepct.MANDT AND cepc.PRCTR = cepct.PRCTR

name: I_CostCenter
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "ICOSTCENTER" AS SELECT
            csks.MANDT AS Client,
            csks.KOKRS AS ControllingArea,
            csks.KOSTL AS CostCenter,
            csks.BUKRS AS CompanyCode,
            csks.PRCTR AS ProfitCenter,
            cskt.KTEXT AS CostCenterName,
            cskt.LTEXT AS CostCenterDescription
        FROM "CSKS" csks
        LEFT OUTER JOIN "CSKT" cskt ON csks.MANDT = cskt.MANDT AND csks.KOKRS = cskt.KOKRS AND csks.KOSTL = cskt.KOSTL

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZVENDOREVAL'
@EndUserText.label: 'Vendor Evaluation Dataset'
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
 
define view Z_I_VENDOR_EVALUATION
as select from ekko
 
inner join ekpo
    on ekko.ebeln = ekpo.ebeln
 
inner join lfa1
    on ekko.lifnr = lfa1.lifnr
 
left outer join mseg
    on ekpo.ebeln = mseg.ebeln
   and ekpo.ebelp = mseg.ebelp
 
left outer join mkpf
    on mseg.mblnr = mkpf.mblnr
   and mseg.mjahr = mkpf.mjahr
 
left outer join rseg
    on ekpo.ebeln = rseg.ebeln
   and ekpo.ebelp = rseg.ebelp
 
left outer join rbkp
    on rseg.belnr = rbkp.belnr
   and rseg.gjahr = rbkp.gjahr
 
{
   
    key ekko.lifnr        as Vendor,
    key ekko.ebeln        as PurchaseOrder,
    key ekpo.ebelp        as POItem,
 
    
    lfa1.name1            as VendorName,
    lfa1.land1            as Country,
 
    
    ekko.bedat            as PODate,
 
    
    ekpo.matnr            as Material,
    ekpo.matkl            as MaterialGroup,
 
    
    ekpo.menge            as OrderedQuantity,
    ekpo.netpr            as POPrice,
 
    
    mkpf.budat            as GRDate,
    mseg.menge            as DeliveredQuantity,
 
    
    rseg.wrbtr            as InvoiceAmount,
    rbkp.bldat            as InvoiceDate
}

    left outer join t005u as _regiont  on  _regiont.land1 = adrc.country

    -- Customer Group 1 Description
    left outer join tvv1t as _kvgr1t  on  _kvgr1t.kvgr1 = knvv.kvgr1

    -- Customer Group 5 Description

{

  @Analytics.dimension: #KEY

  @Analytics.dimension: #KEY

sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC10 - Invoice 3-Way Match: Invoice + PO + GR + Vendor + Variance'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC10_INVOICE_MATCH_INPUT
  as select from rbkp   as InvHdr
  inner join    rseg    as InvItem  on  InvItem.belnr  = InvHdr.belnr
                                    and InvItem.gjahr  = InvHdr.gjahr
  inner join    ekko    as POHdr    on  POHdr.ebeln     = InvItem.ebeln
  inner join    ekpo    as POItem   on  POItem.ebeln    = InvItem.ebeln
                                    and POItem.ebelp    = InvItem.ebelp
  left outer join eket  as POSched  on  POSched.ebeln   = InvItem.ebeln
                                    and POSched.ebelp   = InvItem.ebelp
  left outer join lfa1  as Vendor   on  Vendor.lifnr    = InvHdr.lifnr
  left outer join mseg  as GRItem   on  GRItem.ebeln    = InvItem.ebeln
                                    and GRItem.ebelp    = InvItem.ebelp
                                    and ( GRItem.bwart = '101' or GRItem.bwart = '105' )
  left outer join mkpf  as GRHdr    on  GRHdr.mblnr     = GRItem.mblnr
                                    and GRHdr.mjahr     = GRItem.mjahr
{
  -- Invoice header
  key InvHdr.belnr                   as InvoiceDocNo,
  key InvHdr.gjahr                   as FiscalYear,
  key InvItem.buzei                  as InvoiceLineNo,
      InvHdr.bukrs                   as CompanyCode,
      InvHdr.lifnr                   as VendorNo,
      Vendor.name1                   as VendorName,
      Vendor.stcd3                   as VendorGSTIN,
      Vendor.ktokk                   as VendorAccountGroup,
      InvHdr.bldat                   as InvoiceDate,
      InvHdr.cpudt                   as EntryDate,
      cast( InvHdr.rmwwr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as GrossInvoiceAmount,
      InvHdr.waers                   as Currency,
      InvHdr.xblnr                   as VendorInvoiceRefNo,
      InvHdr.rbstat                  as InvoiceStatus,

  -- Invoice line
      InvItem.matnr                  as MaterialNo,
      POItem.txz01                  as MaterialDescription,
      cast( InvItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as InvoiceQuantity,
      InvItem.meins                  as UnitOfMeasure,
      cast( InvItem.wrbtr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as InvoiceLineAmount,
      InvItem.mwskz                  as TaxCode,

  -- PO reference
      POItem.ebeln                   as PurchaseOrderNo,
      POItem.ebelp                   as POItemNo,
      cast( POItem.netpr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as POUnitPrice,
      cast( POItem.peinh as abap.dec(5,0) )  as POPriceUnit,
      cast( POItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as POOrderedQuantity,
      POHdr.ekorg                    as PurchasingOrganisation,
      POHdr.ekgrp                    as PurchasingGroup,
      POHdr.bedat                    as POCreationDate,
      POSched.eindt                  as POScheduledDeliveryDate,

  -- Goods receipt reference
      GRItem.mblnr                   as GoodsReceiptDocNo,
      cast( GRItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as GRQuantity,
      GRHdr.budat                    as GRPostingDate,

  -- 3-Way match computed fields (scoring engine inputs)
      cast(
        case when cast( InvItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) = 0
             then cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,5) )
             else cast( InvItem.wrbtr as abap.dec(15,2) ) / cast( InvItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) )
        end
      as abap.dec(15,5) )            as InvoiceUnitPrice,

      cast(
        case when cast( InvItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) = 0
               or cast( POItem.netpr as abap.dec(15,2) ) = 0
             then cast( 0 as abap.dec(6,2) )
             else abs(
                    ( cast( InvItem.wrbtr as abap.dec(15,2) ) * cast( POItem.peinh as abap.dec(5,0) ) )
                    /
                    ( cast( InvItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) * cast( POItem.netpr as abap.dec(15,2) ) )
                    - 1
                  ) * 100
        end
      as abap.dec(6,2) )              as PriceVariancePct,

      cast(
        case when cast( GRItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) = 0
             then cast( 0 as abap.dec(6,2) )
             else abs( cast( InvItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) - cast( GRItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) )
                    / cast( GRItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) * 100
        end
      as abap.dec(6,2) )              as QuantityVariancePct,

  -- Duplicate detection helper
      case when InvHdr.xblnr <> '' then 'REF_PRESENT' else 'NO_REF' end as DuplicateDetectionFlag,

  -- Match status pre-assessment
      case
        when GRItem.mblnr is null     then 'NO_GR'
        when POItem.ebeln is null     then 'NO_PO'
        else                               'THREE_WAY_POSSIBLE'
      end                            as MatchStatus
}
where ( InvHdr.rbstat = 'A' or InvHdr.rbstat = 'B' )
  and InvHdr.stblg = ''

name: ZAI_UC11_SUPPLIER_RISK_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC11 - Supplier Risk: Vendor KPIs + OTD + QM Rejections + Invoicing'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC11_SUPPLIER_RISK_INPUT
  as select from lfa1   as Vendor
  left outer join lfm1  as VendPurch on  VendPurch.lifnr = Vendor.lifnr
  left outer join ekko  as POHdr     on  POHdr.lifnr   = Vendor.lifnr
  left outer join ekpo  as POItem    on  POItem.ebeln   = POHdr.ebeln
                                      and POItem.loekz  = ' '
  left outer join eket  as POSched   on  POSched.ebeln  = POItem.ebeln
                                      and POSched.ebelp = POItem.ebelp
  left outer join mseg  as GRLine    on  GRLine.ebeln   = POItem.ebeln
                                      and GRLine.ebelp  = POItem.ebelp
                                      and GRLine.bwart  = '101'
  left outer join mkpf  as GRHdr     on  GRHdr.mblnr   = GRLine.mblnr
                                      and GRHdr.mjahr   = GRLine.mjahr
  left outer join qmel  as QMLot     on  QMLot.ebeln   = POHdr.ebeln
  left outer join rbkp  as InvHdr    on  InvHdr.lifnr  = Vendor.lifnr
                                      and InvHdr.stblg  = ''
{
  -- Vendor identification
  key Vendor.lifnr                    as VendorNo,
      Vendor.name1                    as VendorName,
      Vendor.land1                    as Country,
      Vendor.ktokk                    as VendorAccountGroup,
      Vendor.spras                    as VendorLanguage,
      Vendor.stcd3                    as VendorGSTIN,

  -- Purchasing data
      VendPurch.ekorg                 as PurchasingOrg,
      VendPurch.waers                 as VendorCurrency,
      cast( VendPurch.minbw as abap.dec(15,2) ) as MinimumOrderValue,

  -- Purchase order line
      POHdr.ebeln                     as PurchaseOrderNo,
      POHdr.bedat                     as POCreationDate,
      POItem.matnr                    as MaterialNo,
      cast( POItem.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as POOrderedQty,
      cast( POItem.netpr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as POUnitPrice,
      POItem.meins                    as UnitOfMeasure,
      POSched.eindt                   as POScheduledDeliveryDate,

  -- Goods receipt (on-time delivery scoring)
      GRHdr.budat                     as GRPostingDate,
      cast( GRLine.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as GRQuantity,

  -- On-time delivery flag
      case
        when GRHdr.budat is null                                 then 'NOT_DELIVERED'
        when GRHdr.budat <= POSched.eindt                         then 'ON_TIME'
        when dats_days_between( POSched.eindt, GRHdr.budat ) <= 3 then 'GRACE_PERIOD'
        else                                                          'LATE'
      end                             as DeliveryStatus,

  -- Delay days (negative = early, positive = late)
      dats_days_between( POSched.eindt, GRHdr.budat ) as DeliveryVarianceDays,

  -- Quantity fill rate
      case when cast( POSched.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) > 0
           then cast( cast( GRLine.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) / cast( POSched.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) * 100 as abap.dec(5,2) )
           else cast( 0 as abap.dec(5,2) )
      end                             as QuantityFillRatePct,

  -- QM rejection data
      QMLot.qmnum                     as InspectionLotNo,
      QMLot.erdat                     as LotCreationDate,

  -- Invoice accuracy
      InvHdr.belnr                    as InvoiceDocNo,
      InvHdr.bldat                    as InvoiceDate,
      cast( InvHdr.rmwwr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as InvoiceGrossAmount,
      InvHdr.rbstat                   as InvoiceStatus
}
where ( Vendor.ktokk = '0001' or Vendor.ktokk = 'KRED' or Vendor.ktokk = 'ZVEN' )

name: ZAI_UC12_CATALOG_ENRICH_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC12 - Catalog Enrichment: PR Free-Text + Material Master Catalog'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC12_CATALOG_ENRICH_INPUT
  as select from eban    as PR
  left outer join ebkn   as PRAcct    on  PRAcct.banfn    = PR.banfn
                                       and PRAcct.bnfpo   = PR.bnfpo
  left outer join mara   as MatMast   on  MatMast.matnr   = PR.matnr
                                       and PR.matnr       <> ''
  left outer join makt   as MatText   on  MatText.matnr   = PR.matnr
                                       and MatText.spras  = $session.system_language
  left outer join marc   as MatPlant  on  MatPlant.matnr  = PR.matnr
                                       and MatPlant.werks = PR.werks
  left outer join marm   as MatUoM    on  MatUoM.matnr    = PR.matnr
                                       and MatUoM.meinh   = PR.meins
  left outer join t023t  as MatGrpTxt on  MatGrpTxt.matkl = MatMast.matkl
                                       and MatGrpTxt.spras = $session.system_language
{
  -- PR identification
  key PR.banfn                         as PurchaseReqNo,
  key PR.bnfpo                         as PRItemNo,
      PR.ernam                         as CreatedBy,
      PR.erdat                         as CreationDate,
      PR.badat                         as PurchaseReqDate,
      PR.werks                         as Plant,
      PR.ekgrp                         as PurchasingGroup,
      PR.statu                         as PRStatus,

  -- Material reference (blank if pure free-text PR)
      PR.matnr                         as MaterialNo,
      PR.txz01                         as FreeTextDescription,
      cast( PR.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as RequestedQuantity,
      PR.meins                         as UnitOfMeasure,
      cast( PR.preis as abap.dec(15,2) ) as RequestedPrice,
      PR.waers                         as Currency,
      PR.afnam                         as RequisitionerName,

  -- Account assignment
      PRAcct.kostl                     as CostCenter,
      PRAcct.sakto                     as GLAccount,
      PRAcct.ps_psp_pnr                as WBSElement,
      PRAcct.aufnr                     as OrderNo,

  -- Existing material master reference (duplicate check baseline)
      MatMast.mtart                    as MaterialType,
      MatMast.matkl                    as MaterialGroup,
      MatGrpTxt.wgbez                  as MaterialGroupDescription,
      MatMast.meins                    as BaseUnitOfMeasure,
      MatMast.normt                    as IndustryStandardDesc,
      MatMast.mstae                    as MaterialStatus,
      MatText.maktx                    as ExistingMaterialDesc,

  -- Plant data for scope check
      MatPlant.ekgrp                   as MaterialPurchGroup,
      MatPlant.maabc                   as ABCIndicator,
      MatPlant.mmsta                   as PlantMaterialStatus,

  -- UoM conversion factor
      MatUoM.umrez                     as NumeratorConversion,
      MatUoM.umren                     as DenominatorConversion,

  -- Agent classification helper flags
      case
        when PR.matnr <> '' then 'MATERIAL_KNOWN'
        when PR.txz01 <> '' then 'FREE_TEXT_ONLY'
        else                     'NO_DESCRIPTION'
      end                              as MaterialReferenceStatus,

      case
        when MatMast.mtart = 'FERT' then 'FINISHED_GOOD'
        when MatMast.mtart = 'HALB' then 'SEMI_FINISHED'
        when MatMast.mtart = 'ROH'  then 'RAW_MATERIAL'
        when MatMast.mtart = 'DIEN' then 'SERVICE'
        else                              'OTHER'
      end                              as MaterialTypeClass
}
where ( PR.statu = 'N' or PR.statu = 'K' )
  and PR.loekz  = ' '

name: ZAI_UC13_INVOICE_CODING_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC13 - Invoice Coding: Parked AP Invoices + GL + CC + PC + Tax'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC13_INVOICE_CODING_INPUT
  as select from bkpf   as FIHdr
  inner join    bseg    as FILine    on  FILine.belnr  = FIHdr.belnr
                                     and FILine.bukrs  = FIHdr.bukrs
                                     and FILine.gjahr  = FIHdr.gjahr
  left outer join lfa1  as Vendor    on  Vendor.lifnr  = FILine.lifnr
  left outer join tka02 as CoArea    on  CoArea.bukrs  = FIHdr.bukrs
  left outer join t001  as CompCode  on  CompCode.bukrs = FIHdr.bukrs
  left outer join skb1  as GLMast    on  GLMast.saknr  = FILine.hkont
                                     and GLMast.bukrs  = FIHdr.bukrs
  left outer join ska1  as GLChart   on  GLChart.ktopl = CompCode.ktopl
                                     and GLChart.saknr = FILine.hkont
  left outer join skat  as GLText    on  GLText.saknr  = FILine.hkont
                                     and GLText.ktopl  = CompCode.ktopl
                                     and GLText.spras  = $session.system_language
  left outer join csks  as CCMast    on  CCMast.kostl  = FILine.kostl
                                     and CCMast.kokrs  = CoArea.kokrs
                                     and CCMast.datbi  >= $session.system_date
  left outer join cskt  as CCText    on  CCText.kostl  = FILine.kostl
                                     and CCText.kokrs  = CoArea.kokrs
                                     and CCText.spras  = $session.system_language
  left outer join cepc  as PCMast    on  PCMast.prctr  = FILine.prctr
                                     and PCMast.kokrs  = CoArea.kokrs
                                     and PCMast.datbi  >= $session.system_date
{
  -- FI Document identification
  key FIHdr.belnr                     as FIDocumentNo,
  key FIHdr.gjahr                     as FiscalYear,
  key FILine.buzei                    as LineItemNo,
      FIHdr.bukrs                     as CompanyCode,
      FIHdr.bldat                     as DocumentDate,
      FIHdr.budat                     as PostingDate,
      FIHdr.blart                     as DocumentType,
      FIHdr.bstat                     as DocumentStatus,
      FIHdr.xblnr                     as ExternalReference,

  -- Vendor
      FILine.lifnr                    as VendorNo,
      Vendor.name1                    as VendorName,
      Vendor.ktokk                    as VendorAccountGroup,

  -- Item text
      FILine.sgtxt                    as ItemText,

  -- Amounts
      cast( FILine.dmbtr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as AmountInLocalCurrency,
      cast( FILine.wrbtr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as AmountInDocCurrency,
      FIHdr.waers                     as DocumentCurrency,

  -- Tax
      FILine.mwskz                    as TaxCode,
      cast( FILine.hwbas as abap.dec(15,2) ) as TaxBaseAmount,

  -- Payment terms
      FILine.zterm                    as PaymentTerms,
      FILine.zfbdt                    as BaselinePaymentDate,

  -- GL account assignment
      FILine.hkont                    as GLAccount,
      GLText.txt20                    as GLAccountShortDesc,
      GLText.txt50                    as GLAccountLongDesc,
      GLChart.ktoks                   as GLAccountGroup,
      GLChart.xloev                   as GLMarkedForDeletion,

  -- Cost centre
      FILine.kostl                    as CostCenter,
      CCText.ktext                    as CostCenterDescription,
      CCMast.abtei                    as CostCenterDepartment,

  -- Profit centre
      FILine.prctr                    as ProfitCenter,
      PCMast.prctr                    as ProfitCenterValidated,

  -- Other account objects
      FILine.aufnr                    as InternalOrder,
      FILine.fkber                    as FunctionalArea,

  -- Pattern consistency flag
      case when GLMast.saknr is not null and GLChart.xloev = ' '
           then 'GL_VALID' else 'GL_INVALID_OR_BLOCKED'
      end                             as GLValidationStatus,

      case when CCMast.kostl is not null
           then 'CC_VALID' else 'CC_NOT_SET'
      end                             as CCValidationStatus
}
where ( FIHdr.blart = 'RE' or FIHdr.blart = 'KR' or FIHdr.blart = 'KG' or FIHdr.blart = 'KZ' )
  and ( FIHdr.bstat = 'V' or FIHdr.bstat = ' ' )
  and FILine.koart = 'K'

name: ZAI_UC15_GST_VALIDATE_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC15 - GST Validation: FI/SD Docs + GSTIN + HSN + Tax'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC15_GST_VALIDATE_INPUT
  as select from bkpf    as FIHdr
  inner join    bseg     as FILine    on  FILine.belnr  = FIHdr.belnr
                                       and FILine.bukrs  = FIHdr.bukrs
                                       and FILine.gjahr  = FIHdr.gjahr
  left outer join vbrk   as BillHdr  on  BillHdr.vbeln  = FIHdr.xblnr
  left outer join vbrp   as BillItem on  BillItem.vbeln  = BillHdr.vbeln
  left outer join kna1   as Customer on  Customer.kunnr  = BillHdr.kunrg
  left outer join lfa1   as Vendor   on  Vendor.lifnr    = FILine.lifnr
  left outer join t007s  as TaxDesc  on  TaxDesc.mwskz  = FILine.mwskz
                                       and TaxDesc.kalsm = 'TAXIN'
                                       and TaxDesc.spras = $session.system_language
{
  key FIHdr.belnr                      as FIDocumentNo,
  key FIHdr.gjahr                      as FiscalYear,
  key FILine.buzei                     as LineItemNo,
      FIHdr.bukrs                      as CompanyCode,
      FIHdr.budat                      as PostingDate,
      FIHdr.bldat                      as DocumentDate,
      FIHdr.blart                      as DocumentType,

  -- Customer GSTIN (AR transactions)
      Customer.stcd3                   as CustomerGSTIN,
      Customer.kunnr                   as CustomerNo,
      Customer.name1                   as CustomerName,

  -- Vendor GSTIN (AP transactions)
      Vendor.stcd3                     as VendorGSTIN,
      Vendor.lifnr                     as VendorNo,
      Vendor.name1                     as VendorName,

  -- Consolidated party GSTIN
      case FIHdr.blart
        when 'RV' then Customer.stcd3
        when 'DR' then Customer.stcd3
        when 'RE' then Vendor.stcd3
        when 'KR' then Vendor.stcd3
        else           Customer.stcd3
      end                              as PartyGSTIN,

  -- HSN Code (from BSEG, confirmed on this system)
      FILine.hsn_sac                   as HSNCode,

  -- Tax
      FILine.mwskz                     as TaxCode,
      TaxDesc.text1                    as TaxCodeDescription,
      cast( FILine.hwbas as abap.dec(15,2) ) as TaxBaseAmount,

  -- Billing amounts
      cast( BillItem.netwr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as TaxableValue,
      cast( BillItem.mwsbp as abap.dec(15,2) ) as TaxAmountBilling,

  -- GSTR-2B Reconciliation reference
      FIHdr.xblnr                      as VendorInvoiceRef,

  -- ITC Eligibility
      case
        when FILine.mwskz = 'I1' or FILine.mwskz = 'I2' or FILine.mwskz = 'I3'
          or FILine.mwskz = 'I4' or FILine.mwskz = 'I5'
          then 'ITC_ELIGIBLE'
        when FILine.mwskz = 'X1' or FILine.mwskz = 'X2' or FILine.mwskz = 'X3'
          then 'ITC_BLOCKED'
        else 'ITC_REVIEW'
      end                              as ITCEligibility,

  -- HSN Status flag
      case when FILine.hsn_sac is not null and FILine.hsn_sac <> ''
           then 'HSN_PRESENT' else 'HSN_MISSING'
      end                              as Gate3_HSNStatus


}
where ( FIHdr.blart = 'RV' or FIHdr.blart = 'DR' or FIHdr.blart = 'RE'
     or FIHdr.blart = 'KR' or FIHdr.blart = 'KG' or FIHdr.blart = 'DZ' )

name: ZAI_UC16_DEMAND_SENSING_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC16 - Demand Sensing: 18M SO History + Stock + MRP + Promo Flag'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC16_DEMAND_SENSING_INPUT
  as select from vbap   as SOItem
  inner join    vbak    as SOHdr    on  SOHdr.vbeln    = SOItem.vbeln
  left outer join lips  as DelItem  on  DelItem.vgbel  = SOItem.vbeln
                                     and DelItem.vgpos  = SOItem.posnr
  left outer join likp  as DelHdr   on  DelHdr.vbeln   = DelItem.vbeln
  left outer join mard  as Stock    on  Stock.matnr    = SOItem.matnr
                                     and Stock.werks    = SOItem.werks
                                     and Stock.lgort    = '0001'
  left outer join marc  as MRPData  on  MRPData.matnr  = SOItem.matnr
                                     and MRPData.werks  = SOItem.werks
  left outer join makt  as MatText  on  MatText.matnr  = SOItem.matnr
                                     and MatText.spras  = $session.system_language
  left outer join mvke  as SalesOrg on  SalesOrg.matnr = SOItem.matnr
                                     and SalesOrg.vkorg = SOHdr.vkorg
                                     and SalesOrg.vtweg = SOHdr.vtweg
{
  key SOItem.vbeln                   as SalesOrderNo,
  key SOItem.posnr                   as SalesOrderItem,
      SOHdr.kunnr                    as CustomerNo,
      SOHdr.vkorg                    as SalesOrg,
      SOHdr.vtweg                    as DistributionChannel,
      SOHdr.spart                    as Division,
      SOItem.matnr                   as MaterialNo,
      MatText.maktx                  as MaterialDescription,
      SOItem.werks                   as Plant,
      SOItem.matkl                   as MaterialGroup,
      cast( SOItem.kwmeng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as OrderQuantity,
      SOItem.meins                   as UnitOfMeasure,
      SOHdr.audat                    as SOCreationDate,
      SOHdr.vdatu                    as RequestedDeliveryDate,
      SOHdr.auart                    as SalesOrderType,

      cast( DelItem.lfimg as abap.dec(13,3) ) as DeliveredQuantity,
      DelItem.meins                  as DeliveryUoM,
      DelHdr.wadat_ist               as ActualGoodsIssueDate,
      DelHdr.vstel                   as ShippingPoint,

      cast( Stock.labst as abap.dec(13,3) ) as UnrestrictedStock,
      cast( Stock.insme as abap.dec(13,3) ) as QualityInspectionStock,
      cast( Stock.umlme as abap.dec(13,3) ) as StockInTransfer,

      cast( MRPData.eisbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) as SafetyStock,
      cast( MRPData.minbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) as ReorderPoint,
      cast( MRPData.mabst as abap.dec(13,3) ) as MaximumStockLevel,
      MRPData.dismm                  as MRPType,
      MRPData.dispo                  as MRPController,
      MRPData.plifz                  as PlannedDeliveryTimeDays,

      case when cast( MRPData.eisbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) > 0
           then cast( cast( Stock.labst as abap.dec(13,3) ) / cast( MRPData.eisbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) as abap.dec(7,1) )
           else cast( 0 as abap.dec(7,1) )
      end                            as ApproxDaysOfSupply,

      case SOHdr.augru
        when 'PROM' then 'PROMOTIONAL'
        when 'SEAS' then 'SEASONAL'
        when 'TEND' then 'TENDER'
        else             'REGULAR'
      end                            as DemandType,

      cast( SalesOrg.aumng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as MinimumOrderQty,
      SalesOrg.vrkme                 as SalesUoM,

      case when SOHdr.auart = 'RE' or SOHdr.auart = 'RK' or SOHdr.auart = 'CR'
           then 'RETURN' else 'FORWARD'
      end                            as DemandDirection
}
where SOItem.abgru = ' '

name: ZAI_UC17_WH_SLOTTING_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC17 - WH Slotting: 12M Movements + Bin Master + Material Dims'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC17_WH_SLOTTING_INPUT
  as select from mseg   as MatDoc
  inner join    mkpf    as MatHdr   on  MatHdr.mblnr   = MatDoc.mblnr
                                     and MatHdr.mjahr   = MatDoc.mjahr
  left outer join mara  as MatMast  on  MatMast.matnr   = MatDoc.matnr
  left outer join makt  as MatText  on  MatText.matnr   = MatDoc.matnr
                                     and MatText.spras  = $session.system_language
{
  key MatDoc.mblnr                   as MaterialDocNo,
  key MatDoc.mjahr                   as DocumentYear,
  key MatDoc.zeile                   as LineItemNo,
      MatDoc.matnr                   as MaterialNo,
      MatText.maktx                  as MaterialDescription,
      MatDoc.werks                   as Plant,
      MatDoc.lgnum                   as WarehouseNo,
      MatDoc.lgtyp                   as StorageType,
      MatDoc.lgpla                   as StorageBin,
      MatHdr.budat                   as PostingDate,
      MatDoc.bwart                   as MovementType,

      case
        when MatDoc.bwart = '201' or MatDoc.bwart = '261' or MatDoc.bwart = '601'
          or MatDoc.bwart = '621' or MatDoc.bwart = '641' then 'GOODS_ISSUE'
        when MatDoc.bwart = '101' or MatDoc.bwart = '501' or MatDoc.bwart = '561'
          or MatDoc.bwart = '651'                          then 'GOODS_RECEIPT'
        else                                                    'TRANSFER'
      end                            as MovementCategory,

      cast( MatDoc.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as MovementQuantity,
      MatDoc.meins                   as UnitOfMeasure,

      cast( MatMast.ntgew as abap.dec(13,3) ) as NetWeightKg,
      cast( MatMast.brgew as abap.dec(13,3) ) as GrossWeightKg,
      MatMast.gewei                  as WeightUnit,
      cast( MatMast.volum as abap.dec(13,3) ) as VolumeM3,
      MatMast.voleh                  as VolumeUnit,
      MatMast.tragr                  as TransportGroup,
      MatMast.matkl                  as MaterialGroup,
      

      cast( 1 as abap.int4 )         as MovementCount,

      case
        when cast( MatMast.ntgew as abap.dec(13,3) ) >= 25 then 'HEAVY'
        when cast( MatMast.ntgew as abap.dec(13,3) ) >= 10 then 'MEDIUM'
        else                                                     'LIGHT'
      end                            as WeightClass
}
where MatDoc.lgnum <> ''
  and ( MatDoc.bwart = '101' or MatDoc.bwart = '201' or MatDoc.bwart = '261'
     or MatDoc.bwart = '501' or MatDoc.bwart = '561' or MatDoc.bwart = '601'

  left outer join afih  as PMOrder   on  PMOrder.equnr   = Equip.equnr
  left outer join iloa  as Location  on  Location.iloan  = PMOrder.iloan
  left outer join eqkt  as EqDesc    on  EqDesc.equnr    = Equip.equnr
                                     and EqDesc.spras    = 'E'

      PMOrder.bautl                 as FailureMode,

      Location.abckz                as ABCIndicator,
      case Location.abckz
        when 'A' then 'CRITICAL'
        when 'B' then 'HIGH'
        when 'C' then 'MEDIUM'
        else          'LOW'

sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC4 - Prod Scheduling: Planned Orders + WC Capacity + SO Priority'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC4_PROD_SCHED_INPUT
  as select from plaf  as PlannedOrder
  inner join    marc   as MatPlant  on  MatPlant.matnr = PlannedOrder.matnr
                                    and MatPlant.werks = PlannedOrder.pwwrk
  left outer join makt as MatText   on  MatText.matnr  = PlannedOrder.matnr
                                    and MatText.spras  = $session.system_language
  left outer join vbap as SOItem    on  SOItem.matnr   = PlannedOrder.matnr
                                    and SOItem.werks   = PlannedOrder.pwwrk
  left outer join vbak as SOHdr     on  SOHdr.vbeln    = SOItem.vbeln
  left outer join vbep as SOSched   on  SOSched.vbeln  = SOItem.vbeln
                                    and SOSched.posnr  = SOItem.posnr
{
  key PlannedOrder.plnum            as PlannedOrderNo,
      PlannedOrder.matnr            as MaterialNo,
      MatText.maktx                 as MaterialDescription,
      PlannedOrder.pwwrk            as Plant,
      PlannedOrder.gsmng            as PlannedQuantity,
      PlannedOrder.meins            as UnitOfMeasure,
      PlannedOrder.paart            as PlanOrderType,
      PlannedOrder.psttr            as BasicStartDate,
     cast( MatPlant.minbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) as ReorderPoint,
      cast( MatPlant.eisbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) as SafetyStock,
      SOHdr.vbeln                   as SalesOrderNo,
      SOHdr.kunnr                   as CustomerNo,
      case SOItem.lprio
        when '01' then 'A1-CRITICAL'
        when '02' then 'A2-HIGH'
        when '03' then 'B1-MEDIUM'
        else           'C1-LOW'
      end                           as PriorityClass,
      SOSched.mbdat                 as MaterialAvailabilityDate,
      MatPlant.dispo                as MRPController
}
where PlannedOrder.paart = 'KD'
   or PlannedOrder.paart = 'LA'

sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC5 - Batch Yield: Process Orders + Batch Classification + Yield'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC5_BATCH_YIELD_INPUT
  as select from afko   as OrderHeader
  inner join afpo as OrderItem    on  OrderItem.aufnr   = OrderHeader.aufnr
  inner join aufk as OrderMaster  on  OrderMaster.aufnr = OrderHeader.aufnr
  left outer join mch1 as Batch      on  Batch.matnr      = OrderItem.matnr
                                      and Batch.charg     = OrderItem.charg
left outer join mcha as BatchVals  on  BatchVals.matnr  = OrderItem.matnr
                                    and BatchVals.werks = OrderMaster.werks
                                    and BatchVals.charg = OrderItem.charg
  left outer join kssk as ObjClass   on  ObjClass.objek   = OrderItem.charg
  left outer join ausp as ClassVals  on  ClassVals.objek  = OrderItem.charg
  left outer join makt as MatText    on  MatText.matnr    = OrderItem.matnr
                                      and MatText.spras   = $session.system_language
{
  key OrderHeader.aufnr                          as ProcessOrderNo,
      OrderItem.matnr                            as MaterialNo,
      MatText.maktx                              as MaterialDescription,
      OrderMaster.werks                          as Plant,
      OrderItem.charg                            as BatchNo,
      cast( OrderHeader.gamng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as PlannedYieldQuantity,
      OrderHeader.gmein                          as UnitOfMeasure,
      OrderHeader.gstrs                          as PlannedStartDate,
      OrderHeader.gltrs                          as PlannedFinishDate,
      OrderMaster.auart                          as ProcessOrderType,
      OrderHeader.plnnr                          as MasterRecipeNo,
      ClassVals.atwrt                            as ParameterValue,
     // ClassVals.atinn                            as CharacteristicInternalNo,
      BatchVals.zusch                            as BatchQualityStatus,
      case when cast( OrderHeader.gamng as abap.dec(13,3) ) > 0
           then cast( cast( OrderHeader.igmng as abap.dec(13,3) ) / cast( OrderHeader.gamng as abap.dec(13,3) ) * 100 as abap.dec(5,2) )
           else cast( 0 as abap.dec(5,2) )
      end                                        as ActualYieldPct,
      cast( OrderHeader.igmng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as ActualYieldQuantity
}
where OrderMaster.auart = 'PI01'
   or OrderMaster.auart = 'PI02'
   or OrderMaster.auart = 'ZPI1'

name: ZAI_UC6_VISION_QM_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC6 - Vision AI QM: Lots + Insp Plan + Defect Master + Results'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION

define view entity ZAI_UC6_VISION_QM_INPUT
  as select from qmel    as Lot
  inner join     mapl    as MatPlan  on  MatPlan.matnr  = Lot.matnr
                                      and MatPlan.werks  = Lot.mawerk
  inner join     plko    as PlanHdr  on  PlanHdr.plnty  = MatPlan.plnty
                                      and PlanHdr.plnnr  = MatPlan.plnnr
                                      and PlanHdr.plnal  = MatPlan.plnal
  inner join     plpo    as PlanOp   on  PlanOp.plnty   = PlanHdr.plnty
                                      and PlanOp.plnnr  = PlanHdr.plnnr
  left outer join plmk   as PlanChar on  PlanChar.plnty = PlanOp.plnty
                                      and PlanChar.plnnr = PlanOp.plnnr
                                      and PlanChar.plnkn = PlanOp.plnkn
                                      and PlanChar.zaehl = PlanOp.zaehl
  left outer join qmfe   as Defects  on  Defects.qmnum  = Lot.qmnum
  left outer join makt   as MatText  on  MatText.matnr  = Lot.matnr
                                      and MatText.spras = $session.system_language
{
  -- Inspection Lot
  key Lot.qmnum                      as InspectionLotNo,
      Lot.matnr                      as MaterialNo,
      MatText.maktx                  as MaterialDescription,
      Lot.mawerk                     as Plant,
      Lot.charg                      as BatchNo,
      Lot.erdat                      as LotCreationDate,

  -- Inspection Plan (provides structure for AI output mapping)
      PlanHdr.plnnr                  as InspectionPlanNo,
      PlanHdr.plnal                  as InspectionPlanVersion,
      PlanHdr.ktext                  as InspectionPlanDesc,
      //PlanOp.vornr                   as OperationInternalNo,
      PlanOp.ltxa1                   as InspectionStepDescription,
      PlanChar.merknr                as CharacteristicNo,
      PlanChar.kurztext              as CharacteristicName,
      PlanChar.masseinhsw            as CharacteristicUoM,
      PlanChar.pmethode               as InspectionMethod,
      PlanChar.stichprver             as SamplingProcedureCode,
      cast( PlanChar.sollwert as abap.dec(13,3) )   as TargetValue,
      cast( PlanChar.toleranzob as abap.dec(13,3) ) as UpperLimit,

  -- Defect data from prior lots (pattern recognition input)
      Defects.fecod                  as DefectCodeNo,
      Defects.fetxt                  as DefectDescription,
      
      Defects.anzfehler               as DefectCount,
      Defects.merknr                 as DefectCharacteristicNo,

  -- Severity class (maps to CNN output classes)
      case Defects.feqklas
        when '3' then 'CRITICAL'
        when '2' then 'MAJOR'
        when '1' then 'MINOR'
        else          'AESTHETIC'
      end                            as SeverityClass
}

name: ZAI_UC7_CREDIT_RELEASE_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC7 - Credit Release: Blocked SO + AR Ageing + Credit Master'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC7_CREDIT_RELEASE_INPUT
  as select from vbak   as SOHdr
  inner join    vbap    as SOItem    on  SOItem.vbeln    = SOHdr.vbeln
  inner join    kna1    as Customer  on  Customer.kunnr  = SOHdr.kunnr
  inner join    tvko    as CompCode  on  CompCode.vkorg  = SOHdr.vkorg
  inner join    knkk    as CreditMst on  CreditMst.kunnr = SOHdr.kunnr
                                     and CreditMst.kkber = SOHdr.kkber
  left outer join acdoca as OpenAR    on  OpenAR.kunnr    = SOHdr.kunnr
                                      and OpenAR.rbukrs   = CompCode.bukrs
                                      and OpenAR.koart    = 'D'
                                      and OpenAR.umskz    = ' '
                                      and OpenAR.augbl    = ''
  left outer join acdoca as ClearedAR on  ClearedAR.kunnr  = SOHdr.kunnr
                                      and ClearedAR.rbukrs = CompCode.bukrs
                                      and ClearedAR.koart  = 'D'
                                      and ClearedAR.umskz  = ' '
                                      and ClearedAR.augbl  <> ''
{
  key SOHdr.vbeln                    as SalesOrderNo,
  key SOItem.posnr                   as SalesOrderItem,
      SOHdr.kunnr                    as CustomerNo,
      Customer.name1                 as CustomerName,
      Customer.land1                 as Country,
      CompCode.bukrs                 as CompanyCode,
      SOHdr.kkber                    as CreditControlArea,
      SOHdr.erdat                    as SOCreationDate,
      cast( SOItem.netwr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as NetOrderValue,
      SOHdr.waerk                    as Currency,
      SOHdr.cmgst                    as CreditBlockCode,

      cast( CreditMst.klimk as abap.dec(15,2) ) as CreditLimit,
      cast( CreditMst.skfor as abap.dec(15,2) ) as ExposureOpenOrders,
      cast( CreditMst.knkli as abap.dec(15,2) ) as CreditExposureTotal,
      CreditMst.crblb                as CreditRating,
      CreditMst.ctlpc                as CreditLimitUtilPct,

      case when cast( CreditMst.klimk as abap.dec(15,2) ) > 0
           then cast( cast( CreditMst.knkli as abap.dec(15,2) ) / cast( CreditMst.klimk as abap.dec(15,2) ) * 100 as abap.dec(5,2) )
           else cast( 100 as abap.dec(5,2) )
      end                            as CreditUtilisationPct,

      -- Open AR (ACDOCA, currently uncleared customer line items)
      OpenAR.belnr                   as ARDocumentNo,
      cast( OpenAR.hsl as abap.dec(15,2) ) as OpenARAmount,
      OpenAR.bldat                   as ARDocumentDate,
      dats_days_between( OpenAR.bldat, $session.system_date ) as DaysOverdue,
      case
        when dats_days_between( OpenAR.bldat, $session.system_date ) <= 30  then 'BUCKET_0_30'
        when dats_days_between( OpenAR.bldat, $session.system_date ) <= 60  then 'BUCKET_31_60'
        when dats_days_between( OpenAR.bldat, $session.system_date ) <= 90  then 'BUCKET_61_90'
        else                                                                      'BUCKET_90_PLUS'
      end                            as AgeingBucket,

      -- Cleared AR (ACDOCA, payment history for DSO-style analysis)
      cast( ClearedAR.hsl as abap.dec(15,2) ) as ClearedAmount,
      ClearedAR.bldat                as ClearedDocDate,
      ClearedAR.augdt                as ClearingDate,
      dats_days_between( ClearedAR.bldat, ClearedAR.augdt ) as DaysToPay
}
where SOHdr.cmgst <> ' '
  and SOItem.abgru = ' '

@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC8 - ATP Promise: SO + Stock + MRP Receipts + Lead Times'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC8_ATP_PROMISE_INPUT
  as select from vbap   as SOItem
  inner join    vbak    as SOHdr     on  SOHdr.vbeln    = SOItem.vbeln
  inner join    vbep    as SchedLine on  SchedLine.vbeln = SOItem.vbeln
                                     and SchedLine.posnr = SOItem.posnr
  left outer join mard  as Stock     on  Stock.matnr    = SOItem.matnr
                                     and Stock.werks    = SOItem.werks
                                     and Stock.lgort    = '0001'
  left outer join marc  as MRPData   on  MRPData.matnr  = SOItem.matnr
                                     and MRPData.werks  = SOItem.werks
  left outer join plaf  as PlndOrd   on  PlndOrd.matnr  = SOItem.matnr
                                     and PlndOrd.pwwrk  = SOItem.werks
                                     and PlndOrd.pedtr  >= $session.system_date
  left outer join ekpo  as POItem    on  POItem.matnr   = SOItem.matnr
                                     and POItem.werks   = SOItem.werks
  left outer join eket  as POSched   on  POSched.ebeln  = POItem.ebeln
                                     and POSched.ebelp  = POItem.ebelp
                                     and POSched.eindt  >= $session.system_date
  left outer join makt  as MatText   on  MatText.matnr  = SOItem.matnr
                                     and MatText.spras  = $session.system_language
{
  -- Sales order identification
  key SOItem.vbeln                   as SalesOrderNo,
  key SOItem.posnr                   as SalesOrderItem,
      SOHdr.kunnr                    as CustomerNo,
      SOItem.matnr                   as MaterialNo,
      MatText.maktx                  as MaterialDescription,
      SOItem.werks                   as Plant,
      cast( SOItem.kwmeng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as OrderQuantity,
      SOItem.meins                   as UnitOfMeasure,
      SOHdr.auart                    as SalesOrderType,

  -- Schedule line
      SchedLine.etenr                as ScheduleLineNo,
      SchedLine.mbdat                as RequestedDeliveryDate,
      cast( SchedLine.wmeng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as ScheduleLineQty,
      SchedLine.wadat                as MaterialAvailabilityDate,
      SchedLine.lddat                as LoadingDate,
      SchedLine.tddat                as TransportationPlanDate,

  -- Stock positions
      cast( Stock.labst as abap.dec(13,3) ) as UnrestrictedStock,
      cast( Stock.insme as abap.dec(13,3) ) as QualityInspectionStock,
      cast( Stock.umlme as abap.dec(13,3) ) as StockInTransfer,
      cast( Stock.einme as abap.dec(13,3) ) as StockInTransit,

  -- MRP parameters (for lead time calculation)
      cast( MRPData.eisbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) as SafetyStock,
      cast( MRPData.minbe as abap.dec(13,3) ) as ReorderPoint,
      MRPData.webaz                  as GRProcessingTimeDays,
      MRPData.dzeit                  as InHouseProdTimeDays,
      MRPData.plifz                  as PlannedDeliveryTimeDays,
      MRPData.dismm                  as MRPType,

  -- Planned receipts (nearest future)
      PlndOrd.plnum                  as PlannedOrderNo,
      PlndOrd.pedtr                  as PlannedReceiptDate,
      cast( PlndOrd.gsmng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as PlannedReceiptQty,

  -- PO scheduled receipts
      POSched.ebeln                  as PurchaseOrderNo,
      POSched.eindt                  as POScheduledReceiptDate,
      cast( POSched.menge as abap.dec(13,3) ) as POScheduledQty,

  -- Customer priority
      case SOItem.lprio
        when '01' then 'A1-CRITICAL'
        when '02' then 'A2-HIGH'
        when '03' then 'B1-MEDIUM'
        else           'C1-LOW'
      end                            as CustomerPriorityClass,

  -- Delivery block
      SOHdr.lifsk                    as DeliveryBlock,
      SOItem.lgort                   as StorageLocation
}

name: ZAI_UC9_PRICING_ANOMALY_INPUT
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK
@EndUserText.label: 'UC9 - Pricing Anomaly: SO Conditions + Manual Override + Margin'
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
define view entity ZAI_UC9_PRICING_ANOMALY_INPUT
  as select from konv   as Cond
  inner join    vbak    as SOHdr   on  SOHdr.knumv     = Cond.knumv
  inner join    vbap    as SOItem  on  SOItem.vbeln    = SOHdr.vbeln
                                    and SOItem.posnr    = Cond.kposn
  left outer join kna1  as Customer  on  Customer.kunnr  = SOHdr.kunnr
  left outer join knvv  as CustSales on  CustSales.kunnr = SOHdr.kunnr
                                     and  CustSales.vkorg = SOHdr.vkorg
                                     and  CustSales.vtweg = SOHdr.vtweg
                                     and  CustSales.spart = SOHdr.spart
  left outer join makt  as MatText   on  MatText.matnr   = SOItem.matnr
                                     and  MatText.spras   = $session.system_language
  left outer join t685t as CondText  on  CondText.kschl  = Cond.kschl
                                     and  CondText.spras  = $session.system_language
{
  -- Sales order identification
  key SOItem.vbeln                   as SalesOrderNo,
  key SOItem.posnr                   as SalesOrderItem,
  key Cond.stunr                     as StepNo,
  key Cond.zaehk                     as ConditionCounter,
      SOHdr.kunnr                    as CustomerNo,
      Customer.name1                 as CustomerName,
      CustSales.kdgrp                as CustomerGroup,
      SOItem.matnr                   as MaterialNo,
      MatText.maktx                  as MaterialDescription,
      SOItem.werks                   as Plant,
      SOItem.matkl                   as MaterialGroup,

  -- Pricing condition details
      Cond.kschl                     as ConditionType,
      CondText.vtext                 as ConditionTypeDescription,
      cast( Cond.kbetr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as ConditionRate,
      Cond.kwaeh                     as ConditionCurrency,
      Cond.krech                     as CalculationType,
      cast( Cond.kawrt as abap.dec(15,2) ) as ConditionBaseValue,
      cast( Cond.kwert as abap.dec(15,2) ) as ConditionValue,

  -- Manual override detection (key anomaly signal)
      Cond.kmprs                     as ManuallyChanged,
      Cond.kfkiv                     as InvoiceCondition,

  -- Discount percentage (extracted from percentage-type conditions)
      case Cond.krech
        when 'A' then cast( Cond.kbetr as abap.dec(15,2) )
        else cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,2) )
      end                            as DiscountPercent,

  -- Sales order value and margin data
      cast( SOItem.kwmeng as abap.dec(13,3) ) as OrderQuantity,
      SOItem.meins                   as UnitOfMeasure,
      cast( SOItem.netwr as abap.dec(15,2) ) as NetItemValue,
      SOItem.waerk                   as Currency,
      SOItem.vgbel                   as ReferenceSONo,

  -- Condition source classification
      case Cond.kmprs
        when 'X' then 'MANUAL_OVERRIDE'
        else          'SYSTEM_DETERMINED'
      end                            as ConditionSource,

  -- Anomaly flags pre-computed for agent
      case when ( Cond.kschl = 'K004' or Cond.kschl = 'K005' or Cond.kschl = 'K007'
                or Cond.kschl = 'RA01' or Cond.kschl = 'HD00' or Cond.kschl = 'RB00' )
            and Cond.kmprs = 'X'
           then 'MANUAL_DISCOUNT' else 'STANDARD'
      end                            as AnomalyIndicator
}
where ( Cond.kschl = 'PR00' or Cond.kschl = 'K004' or Cond.kschl = 'K005'
     or Cond.kschl = 'K007' or Cond.kschl = 'RA01' or Cond.kschl = 'RB00'
     or Cond.kschl = 'HD00' or Cond.kschl = 'KP00' or Cond.kschl = 'ZPR0' )

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'BOM Comparison CDS'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZBOM_COMP_CDS
  with parameters
    P_AUFNR : aufnr,                               //Production Order
    
     p_matnr : matnr,                              //Finished Material
     
    p_werks : werks_d //Plant
    
    
  //    p_date_from  : budat,
  //    p_date_to    : budat

  as select from    aufk                                    //Production Header Table

    inner join      afko   on aufk.aufnr = afko.aufnr       //Production Order Master Information Table
                                                            //To get the finished materials

    inner join      resb   on aufk.aufnr = resb.aufnr       //Stores all the planned BOM Components and their planned quantities
                          
    left outer join matdoc on  matdoc.aufnr = resb.aufnr    //Matdoc stores actual material movements in S/4HANA
                           and matdoc.matnr = resb.matnr
                           and matdoc.bwart = '261'         //Good Issue to Production Order
                           //Raw materials have been issued from warehouse to a production order for manufacturing.

  //    left outer join     mkpf   on matdoc.mblnr  =  mkpf.mblnr
  //                           and mkpf.mjahr = matdoc.mjahr




    left outer join makt   on  makt.matnr = resb.matnr     //Stores description
                           and makt.spras = $session.system_language


    left outer join jest   on jest.objnr = aufk.objnr      //Stores Production Order Status.

//    left outer join mkpf   on  mkpf.mblnr = matdoc.mblnr
//                           and mkpf.mjahr = matdoc.mjahr



{

  key aufk.aufnr           as ProductionOrder,
      aufk.werks           as Plant,
      jest.stat            as OrderStatus,
      resb.matnr           as ComponentMaterial,
      makt.maktx           as ComponentDescription,



      @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'UOM'
      resb.bdmng           as PlannedQty,


      //       @Semantics.unitOfMeasure
      resb.meins           as UOM,

      //        resb.meins as UOM,
      //        resb.bdmng as PlannedQty,
      
      
      @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'UOM2'
      matdoc.menge         as ActualQtyIssued,

      resb.meins           as UOM2,



      cast(
          case
              when resb.bdmng <> 0

              then
            (
              cast( matdoc.menge as abap.fltp ) /
              cast( resb.bdmng as abap.fltp  )
            ) * cast( 100 as abap.fltp )

          else cast( 0 as abap.fltp )

        end
        as abap.fltp
      )                    as GRRate,

      case
          when matdoc.menge = resb.bdmng  //bdmng = requirement quantity or Planned Quantity
          then 'MATCH'

          when matdoc.menge > resb.bdmng
          then 'OVER ISSUE'

          when matdoc.menge < resb.bdmng
          then 'UNDER ISSUE'

          else 'NOT ISSUED'
      end                  as ConsumptionStatus,
      
      

      // cast(mkpf.budat as dats) as PostingDate,
      
      
      matdoc.budat           as PostingDate,
      matdoc.vgart           as event_type,
      //mkpf.blaum               as doc_type,
      matdoc.bwart         as MovementType,
      matdoc.mblnr         as MaterialDocument,
      matdoc.mjahr         as MaterialDocYear,

      matdoc.mblnr           as MKPFDocument,
      matdoc.mjahr           as MKPFYear,

      $session.system_date as SystemDate,



      case

      when matdoc.menge is null
      then 'Not yet issued - stock shortage?'

      when matdoc.menge = resb.bdmng
      then 'Exact match'

      when matdoc.menge > resb.bdmng
      then 'Over-issue - scrap loss'

      when matdoc.menge < resb.bdmng
      then 'Under-issue - partial GI pending'

      else 'Review Required'

      end                  as Remarks,

      resb.meins           as UOM3


}

where
      aufk.aufnr = $parameters.P_AUFNR

  and afko.plnbez = $parameters.p_matnr

  and aufk.werks = $parameters.p_werks

@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]

    dataClass: #MIXED
}
@Analytics.dataCategory: #CUBE

define view entity ZC_LocationSalesReport
  as select from ZI_LocationSales
{

  key werks,
  key vkbur,
  key bezei,
  key spart,
  key vtext,
  key bzirk,

      sum(
          cast(
              case
                  when vbtyp_ana = 'M'
                  then netwr
                  else cast( 0 as abap.curr(15,2) )
              end
          as abap.dec(23,2))
      ) as GrossSales,

      sum(
          cast(
              case
                  when vbtyp_ana = 'O'
                   and ( augru_auft = 'Z01'
                      or augru_auft = 'Z09' )
                  then netwr
                  else cast( 0 as abap.curr(15,2) )
              end
          as abap.dec(23,2))
      ) as ReturnSales,

      sum(
          cast(
              case
                  when augru_auft = 'Z02'
                  then netwr
                  else cast( 0 as abap.curr(15,2) )
              end
          as abap.dec(23,2))
      ) as Damage,

      sum(
          cast(
              case
                  when augru_auft = 'Z03'
                  then netwr
                  else cast( 0 as abap.curr(15,2) )
              end
          as abap.dec(23,2))
      ) as Expiry,

      sum(
          cast(
              case
                  when augru_auft = 'Z04'
                  then netwr
                  else cast( 0 as abap.curr(15,2) )
              end
          as abap.dec(23,2))
      ) as PriceDiff,

      sum(
          cast(
              case
                  when augru_auft = 'Z05'
                  then netwr
                  else cast( 0 as abap.curr(15,2) )
              end
          as abap.dec(23,2))
      ) as Secondary,

      sum(
          cast(
              case
                  when augru_auft = 'Z06'
                  then netwr
                  else cast( 0 as abap.curr(15,2) )
              end
          as abap.dec(23,2))
      ) as EPD

}
group by
  werks,
  vkbur,
  bezei,
  spart,
  vtext,

name: ZC_MYQ_ORDERSUMMARY
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'MYQ: Production Order Summary'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #CONSUMPTION
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #L, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZC_MYQ_OrderSummary
  as select from afko
    inner join      aufk                         on  aufk.aufnr = afko.aufnr
    inner join      afpo                         on  afpo.aufnr = afko.aufnr
                                                 and afpo.posnr = '0001'
    left outer join t001w                        on  t001w.werks = afpo.pwerk
    left outer join ZI_MYQ_OrderConfAgg     as C on  C.ProductionOrder = afko.aufnr
    left outer join ZI_MYQ_OrderMovementAgg as M on  M.ProductionOrder = afko.aufnr
    left outer join ZI_MYQ_OrderInspAgg     as I on  I.ProductionOrder = afko.aufnr
{
  key afko.aufnr   as ProductionOrder,
      aufk.auart   as OrderType,
      aufk.autyp   as OrderCategory,
      aufk.refnr   as ReferenceOrder,
      aufk.erdat   as OrderCreatedOn,
      afko.gstrp   as BasicStartDate,
      afko.gltrp   as BasicFinishDate,
      afpo.matnr   as Material,
      afko.stlnr   as BillOfMaterial,
      afko.stlal   as BOMAlternative,
      afpo.pwerk   as Plant,
      t001w.name1  as PlantName,
      afpo.meins   as OrderUnit,
      cast( afpo.psmng as abap.dec(15,3) ) as OrderQuantity,          // rate denominator candidate
      cast( afko.gasmg as abap.dec(15,3) ) as PlannedScrapQuantity,   // order level only
      coalesce( C.YieldQuantity,  cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) )        as YieldQuantity,
      coalesce( C.ScrapQuantity,  cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) )        as ScrapQuantity,
      coalesce( C.ReworkQuantity, cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) )        as ReworkQuantity,
      coalesce( C.HasUnitMismatch, 0 )                                 as HasUnitMismatch,
      coalesce( C.ConfirmationCount, 0 )                               as ConfirmationCount,
      coalesce( M.ProductionGRQuantity, cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) )  as ProductionGRQuantity,
      coalesce( M.ConsumptionQuantity,  cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) )  as ConsumptionQuantity,
      coalesce( M.ScrapPostedQuantity,  cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) ) as ScrapPostedQuantity,
      coalesce( I.InspectionQuantity,   cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) )  as InspectionQuantity,
      coalesce( I.InspectionLotCount, 0 )                              as InspectionLotCount,
      1 as ProductionOrderCount
}
where aufk.autyp = '10' or aufk.autyp = '40'

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZCVPOOVW'
@AbapCatalog.compiler.compareFilter: true
@AbapCatalog.preserveKey: true
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'PO Overview Composite'
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
define view ZC_PO_Overview as select from ZI_PO_Header1 as H
inner join ZI_PO_Item as I
on H.PurchaseOrder = I.PurchaseOrder

left outer join ZI_PO_Schedule as S
on I.PurchaseOrder = S.PurchaseOrder
and I.POItem = S.POItem

association [0..1] to ZI_Vendor as _vendor
on $projection.Vendor = _vendor.Vendor

association [1..1] to ZI_Material as _material 
on $projection.Material = _material.Material

association [0..1] to t001w as _plant
on $projection.Plant = _plant.werks
{
    key H.PurchaseOrder,
    key I.POItem,
    
        H.CompanyCode,
        H.PurchasingOrg,
        H.Vendor,
        _vendor.VendorName,
        
        I.Material,
        _material.MaterialDescription,
        
        I.Plant,
        _plant.name1 as plantName,
        
        H.PODate,
        S.ScheduledDeliveryDate,
        
        I.OrderQuantity,
        S.GRQuantity,
        I.DeliveryComplete,
        H.Currency,
        
        @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'Currency'
        I.NetValue,
        
         dats_days_between( 
          H.PODate, 
          cast( $session.system_date as abap.dats )
        ) as POAgeDays,

         dats_days_between(
            H.PODate,
            S.ScheduledDeliveryDate
        ) as LeadTimeDays,

       dats_days_between(
            S.ScheduledDeliveryDate,
         cast ( $session.system_date as abap.dats )
        ) as DaysOverdue,
        
        cast(
      case 
        when I.OrderQuantity <> 0
            then (
            cast( S.GRQuantity as abap.fltp )  
      /
               cast( I.OrderQuantity as abap.fltp )
                )*cast( 100 as abap.fltp )
            else cast( 0 as abap.fltp )
        end as abap.fltp ) as grrate,
        case 
        when S.GRQuantity >= I.OrderQuantity
        then 'Fully Received'
when S.GRQuantity > 0 
then 'Partial'
else 'Not Received' 
end as DeliveryStatus,
        
       case
 
  when I.DeliveryComplete = 'X'
  then 'Closed'
 
  when S.ScheduledDeliveryDate < H.PODate
  then 'Overdue'
 
  else 'On Track'
 
end as OverdueFlag, 
        
    _vendor,   
    _material,
    _plant
    
}

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZVPURREGP2'
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Purchase Register - P2'
@OData.publish: true
define view ZC_Purchase_Register_P2
  with parameters
    p_bukrs_low : bukrs,
    p_bukrs_high: bukrs,
    p_gjahr_low : gjahr,
    p_gjahr_high: gjahr,
    p_budat_low : budat,
    p_budat_high: budat,
    p_werks_low : werks_d,
    p_werks_high: werks_d

  as select from bkpf as Bkpf

  inner join bseg as Bseg
    on  Bseg.bukrs = Bkpf.bukrs
    and Bseg.belnr = Bkpf.belnr
    and Bseg.gjahr = Bkpf.gjahr
    and Bseg.buzid = ' '
    and (
             ( ( Bkpf.blart = 'KR' or Bkpf.blart = 'KA' ) and Bkpf.xreversal =  '2' and Bseg.shkzg = 'H' )
          or ( ( Bkpf.blart = 'KR' or Bkpf.blart = 'KA' ) and Bkpf.xreversal <> '2' and Bseg.shkzg = 'S' )
          or (   Bkpf.blart = 'KG'                        and Bkpf.xreversal =  '2' and Bseg.shkzg = 'S' )
          or (   Bkpf.blart = 'KG'                        and Bkpf.xreversal <> '2' and Bseg.shkzg = 'H' )
        )

  association [0..1] to ZI_PurRegP2_SignFactor as _Sign
    on  _Sign.bukrs = Bkpf.bukrs
    and _Sign.belnr = Bkpf.belnr
    and _Sign.gjahr = Bkpf.gjahr

  association [0..1] to ZI_PurRegP2_FaglFlexA as _Fagl
    on  _Fagl.Bukrs  = Bseg.bukrs
    and _Fagl.Belnr  = Bseg.belnr
    and _Fagl.Gjahr  = Bseg.gjahr
    and _Fagl.Buzei3 = Bseg.buzei

  association [0..1] to ZI_PurRegP2_TaxBreakup as _Tax
    on  _Tax.bukrs = Bseg.bukrs
    and _Tax.belnr = Bseg.belnr
    and _Tax.gjahr = Bseg.gjahr
    and _Tax.txgrp = Bseg.txgrp
    and _Tax.shkzg = Bseg.shkzg

  association [0..1] to ZI_PurRegP2_VatLine as _Vat
    on  _Vat.bukrs = Bseg.bukrs
    and _Vat.belnr = Bseg.belnr
    and _Vat.gjahr = Bseg.gjahr

  association [0..1] to ZI_PurRegP2_GrossTotal as _Gross
    on  _Gross.bukrs = Bseg.bukrs
    and _Gross.belnr = Bseg.belnr
    and _Gross.gjahr = Bseg.gjahr

  association [0..1] to ZI_PurRegP2_Vendor as _Vendor
    on  _Vendor.bukrs = Bseg.bukrs
    and _Vendor.belnr = Bseg.belnr
    and _Vendor.gjahr = Bseg.gjahr

{
  key Bseg.bukrs                                              as Bukrs,
  key Bseg.belnr                                              as Belnr,
  key Bkpf.gjahr                                               as Gjahr,
  key Bseg.buzei                                               as Buzei,

      Bseg.hkont                                               as Hkont,
      Bseg.mwskz                                               as Mwskz,
      Bkpf.blart                                                as Blart,

      @EndUserText.label: 'Plant'
      Bseg.werks                                                as Werks,

      -- amounts, sign-flipped per original reversal logic --
      Bseg.wrbtr * _Sign.SignFactor                             as Wrbtr,
      Bseg.dmbtr * _Sign.SignFactor                             as Dmbtr,

      Bseg.kostl                                                as Kostl,
      coalesce( Bseg.prctr, _Fagl.Prctr )                       as Prctr,
      coalesce( Bseg.gsber, _Fagl.Gsber )                       as Gsber,
      Bseg.sgtxt                                                as Text1Tax,

      coalesce( _Tax.TaxableVal, Bseg.hwbas ) * _Sign.SignFactor as TaxableVal,

      _Tax.VatRate                                              as VatRate,
      _Vat.VatAmt                                               as VatAmt,

      ( coalesce( _Vat.VatAmt, 0 ) + coalesce( _Gross.GrossCreditSum, 0 ) ) * _Sign.SignFactor as Gross,

      Bkpf.bldat                                                as Bldat,
      Bkpf.budat                                                as Postdat,
      Bkpf.waers                                                as Waers,
      Bkpf.kursf                                                as Kursf,
      Bkpf.xblnr                                                as Xblnr,

      _Vendor.Lifnr                                             as Lifnr,
      _Vendor.Name1                                             as Name1,
      _Vendor.Ort01                                             as Ort01,
      _Vendor.VatNo                                             as VatNo,
      _Vendor.Region                                            as Region
}
where ( Bkpf.blart = 'KR' or Bkpf.blart = 'KG' or Bkpf.blart = 'KA' )
  and Bkpf.bukrs between $parameters.p_bukrs_low and $parameters.p_bukrs_high
  and Bkpf.gjahr between $parameters.p_gjahr_low and $parameters.p_gjahr_high
  and Bkpf.budat between $parameters.p_budat_low and $parameters.p_budat_high

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'CDS'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZCDS_BOM_COMP_DEMO
    
  with parameters
    p_aufnr : aufnr, //abap.char(12),   //Production Order  (AUFNR length)
    p_matnr : matnr, //abap.char(18),   //Finished Material  (MATNR length, 18 for S/4HANA)
    p_werks : werks_d,  // abap.char(4),    //Plant               (WERKS_D length)
    p_date  : erdat //abap.dats        //Date

  as select from aufk  //Production Header Table

  inner join afko
    on aufk.aufnr = afko.aufnr

  inner join resb
    on aufk.aufnr = resb.aufnr

  left outer join mseg
    on  mseg.aufnr = resb.aufnr
    and mseg.matnr = resb.matnr

  left outer join makt
    on  makt.matnr = resb.matnr
    and makt.spras = $session.system_language

  left outer join jest
    on  jest.objnr = aufk.objnr

{
  key aufk.aufnr                  as ProductionOrder,
      afko.plnbez                 as FinishedMaterial,
      aufk.werks                  as Plant,
      jest.stat                   as OrderStatus,
      resb.matnr                  as ComponentMaterial,
      makt.maktx                  as ComponentDescription,

      //@Semantics.unitOfMeasure: true
      resb.meins                  as UoM,

      @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'UoM'
      resb.bdmng                  as PlannedQty,

      @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'UoM'
      mseg.menge                  as ActualQtyIssued,

      @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'UoM'
      ( mseg.menge - resb.bdmng ) as Variance,

      case
        when resb.bdmng <> 0
          then cast( ( ( mseg.menge - resb.bdmng ) / resb.bdmng ) * 100 as abap.dec( 15, 2 ) )
        else cast( 0 as abap.dec( 15, 2 ) )
      end                          as VariancePercent,

      case
        when mseg.menge =  resb.bdmng then 'MATCH'
        when mseg.menge >  resb.bdmng then 'OVER ISSUE'
        when mseg.menge <  resb.bdmng then 'UNDER ISSUE'
        else 'NOT ISSUED'
      end                          as ConsumptionStatus,

      mseg.budat_mkpf              as PostingDate,

      $session.system_date         as SystemDate,

      case
        when mseg.menge > resb.bdmng then 'Extra Consumption'
        else 'OK'
      end                          as Remarks

}

where
      aufk.aufnr  = $parameters.p_aufnr
 // and afko.plnbez = $parameters.p_matnr
  and aufk.werks  = $parameters.p_werks

define view entity ZCDS_GST_INWARD_INV
  as select from rbkp as Header
    inner join      rseg       as Item   on  Item.belnr = Header.belnr
                                         and Item.gjahr = Header.gjahr
    inner join      lfa1       as Vendor on  Vendor.lifnr = Header.lifnr
    left outer join marc       as Plant  on  Plant.matnr = Item.matnr
                                         and Plant.werks = Item.werks
    left outer join makt       as Text   on  Text.matnr = Item.matnr
                                         and Text.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join j_1bbranch as Branch on  Branch.bukrs  = Header.bukrs
                                         and Branch.branch = Header.bupla
{
  key Header.belnr  as invoice_number,
  key Header.gjahr  as fiscal_year,
  key Item.buzei    as invoice_item_no,
      Header.xblnr  as supplier_invoice_ref,
      Header.bldat  as invoice_date,
      Header.budat  as posting_date,
      cast( 'AP' as abap.char(2) ) as direction,
      cast( case when Header.xrech = ''
                 then 'CREDIT_NOTE' else 'B2B' end as abap.char(12) ) as invoice_type,
      Header.bukrs    as company_code,
      Header.bupla    as business_place,
      Branch.gstin    as buyer_gstin,
      Vendor.lifnr    as counterparty_id,
      Vendor.name1    as counterparty_name,
      Vendor.stcd3    as counterparty_gstin,
      Vendor.stcd3    as seller_gstin,
      Vendor.regio    as supplier_region,
      Plant.steuc     as hsn_sac,
      Item.matnr      as material,
      Text.maktx      as item_desc,
      Item.mwskz      as tax_code,
 
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'currency'
      Item.wrbtr      as taxable_value,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'currency'
      Header.wmwst1   as header_total_tax,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'currency'
      Header.rmwwr    as header_gross_amount,
      Header.waers    as currency,
 
      Header.cpudt    as last_changed_date
}
where Header.rbstat = '5'   -- posted only
  and Header.stblg  = ''    -- not reversed

sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'UC15 GST Outward Sales Invoices'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZCDS_GST_OUTWARD_INV
  as select from vbrk as Header
    inner join      vbrp           as Item     on  Item.vbeln = Header.vbeln
    inner join      kna1           as Customer on  Customer.kunnr = Header.kunrg
    left outer join marc           as Plant    on  Plant.matnr = Item.matnr
                                               and Plant.werks = Item.werks
    left outer join j_1bbranch     as Branch   on  Branch.bukrs  = Header.bukrs
                                               and Branch.branch = Header.bupla
    left outer join ZI_GST_OUT_TAX as Tax      on  Tax.knumv = Header.knumv
                                               and Tax.kposn = Item.posnr
    left outer join ZI_GST_IRN     as Irn      on  Irn.bukrs = Header.bukrs
                                               and Irn.docno = Header.vbeln
    left outer join ZI_GST_EWB     as Ewb      on  Ewb.bukrs = Header.bukrs
                                               and Ewb.docno = Header.vbeln
{
  key Header.vbeln  as invoice_number,
  key Item.posnr    as invoice_item_no,
      Header.fkdat  as invoice_date,
      cast( 'AR' as abap.char(2) ) as direction,
      Header.fkart  as billing_type,
      cast( case
              when Header.fkart = 'G2' or Header.fkart = 'RE' then 'CREDIT_NOTE'
              when Header.fkart = 'L2'                        then 'DEBIT_NOTE'
              when Customer.stcd3 = ''                        then 'B2C'
              else 'B2B'
            end as abap.char(12) ) as invoice_type,
      Header.bukrs    as company_code,
      Header.bupla    as business_place,
      Branch.gstin    as seller_gstin,
      Customer.kunnr  as counterparty_id,
      Customer.name1  as counterparty_name,
      Customer.stcd3  as counterparty_gstin,
      Customer.stcd3  as buyer_gstin,
      Header.regio    as place_of_supply,
      Plant.steuc     as hsn_sac,
      Item.arktx      as item_desc,
 
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'currency'
      Item.netwr      as taxable_value,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'currency'
      Item.mwsbp      as total_tax,
      cast( Item.netwr as abap.dec(15,2) )
        + cast( Item.mwsbp as abap.dec(15,2) ) as total_amount,
      Header.waerk    as currency,
 
      Tax.cgst_rate,
      Tax.sgst_rate,
      Tax.igst_rate,
      Tax.cess_rate,
 
      Irn.irn,
      Ewb.eway_bill_number,
 
      case when Header.aedat = '00000000'
           then Header.erdat
           else Header.aedat end as last_changed_date
}
where Header.fksto = ''     -- not cancelled
  and Header.sfakn = ''     -- not itself a cancellation document

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Demo DPR'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZCDS_IRSH
    with parameters
    
     p_date     : budat,
    p_work     : arbpl,
    p_order    : aufnr,
    p_material : matnr

 as select from afru as A
    left outer join afpo as P
        on A.aufnr = P.aufnr

    left outer join crhd as C
        on A.arbid = C.objid

    left outer join qals as Q
        on A.aufnr = Q.aufnr

    left outer join qamv as V
        on Q.prueflos = V.prueflos

    left outer join qamr as R
        on Q.prueflos = R.prueflos
{
    key A.rueck                         as ConfirmationNo,
    key A.rmzhl                         as ConfirmationCounter,

        A.budat                         as PostingDate,
        A.ersda                         as DocumentDate,

        P.dwerk                         as Plant,

        A.kaptprog                      as Shift,

        A.arbid                         as WorkCenterObjId,
        C.arbpl                         as WorkCenter,

        A.aufnr                         as ProductionOrder,

        P.matnr                         as Material,

        A.meinh                         as UoM,

        cast(
            A.lmnga
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as ConfirmedYield,

        cast(
            A.xmnga
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as ConfirmedScrap,

        cast(
            A.lmnga - A.xmnga
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as GoodProductionQty,

        cast(
            P.psmng - A.lmnga
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as PendingQty,

        cast(
            V.sollwert
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as StdCycleTime,

        cast(
            R.original_input
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as ActualCycleTime,

        cast(
            R.original_input
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as ActualWeight,

        cast(
            A.ism03
            as abap.dec(15,3)
        )                               as MachineTime,

        Q.prueflos                      as InspectionLot

}
where

      A.budat = $parameters.p_date

  and (
         $parameters.p_order = ''
         or A.aufnr = $parameters.p_order
      )

  and (
         $parameters.p_material = ''
         or P.matnr = $parameters.p_material
      )

  and (
         $parameters.p_work = ''
         or C.arbpl = $parameters.p_work
      );

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
