@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true

define view entity zDPR_REPORT1
  with parameters

    p_plant : werks_d,
    p_date  : budat,
    p_order : aufnr
  as select from    afru // Stores production order confirmation

    inner join      aufk                 on afru.aufnr = aufk.aufnr //production order header

    inner join      afpo                 on afru.aufnr = afpo.aufnr //production order item

    left outer join crhd                 on afru.arbid = crhd.objid //Work Center master data

    left outer join qals                 on afru.aufnr = qals.aufnr //Inspection Lot Header

    left outer join qamb                 on qals.prueflos = qamb.prueflos //Links the Inspection Lot with the Material Document

    left outer join matdoc               on qamb.mblnr = matdoc.mblnr


//    left outer join ZDPR_YIELD_SUM as YS on afru.aufnr = YS.aufnr

    left outer join ZDPR_QM_DATA   as QM   on afru.aufnr = QM.Production_Order //Quality Management data 

{

  key afru.rueck                           as Confirmation_No,

  key afru.rmzhl                           as Confirmation_Counter,

      afru.budat                           as Posting_Date,

      afru.ersda                           as Document_Date,

      afpo.dwerk                           as Plant,

      afru.kaptprog                        as Shift,

      crhd.arbpl                           as Work_Center,

      afru.aufnr                           as Production_Order,

      aufk.auart                           as Order_Type,

      afpo.matnr                           as Material,

      matdoc.lgort                         as Good_Production_Location,

      matdoc.lgort                         as Rejected_Stock_Location,
    

      cast( afpo.psmng as abap.dec(15,3) ) as Order_Qty,

      afru.meinh                           as UoM,

      cast( afru.lmnga as abap.dec(15,3))  as Confirmed_Yield,

      cast( afru.xmnga as abap.dec(15,3))  as Confirmed_Scrap,

      cast(

          afru.lmnga - afru.xmnga

          as abap.dec(15,3)

      )                                    as Good_Production_Qty,




      cast(
           
          cast( afpo.psmng as abap.dec(15,3) ) 
         - cast( afru.lmnga as abap.dec(15,3) ) // order_qty -yield quantity - = pending qty
          as abap.dec(15,3)
      )                                    as Pending_Qty,

      QM.Std_Cycle_Time,

      QM.Act_Cycle_Time,

      QM.Std_Weight,

      QM.Actual_Weight // no value


}

where

      afpo.dwerk = $parameters.p_plant

  and afru.budat = $parameters.p_date

  and afru.aufnr = $parameters.p_order;

ZI_ABC_MAINTORDERFACT
sqlDdl:
// Z_I_MAINT_ORDER - grain: one maintenance order (AUFK, AUTYP = 30).
// Carries duration, downtime and breakdown from the order's notification (QMIH).
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'ABC: Maintenance Order Fact'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #L, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_ABC_MaintOrderFact
  as select from aufk
    inner join      afih                                 on  afih.aufnr = aufk.aufnr
    inner join      afko                                 on  afko.aufnr = aufk.aufnr
    // ---- technical object ----
    left outer join iloa                                 on  iloa.iloan = afih.iloan
    left outer join equi                                 on  equi.equnr = afih.equnr
    left outer join eqkt                                 on  eqkt.equnr = afih.equnr
                                                         and eqkt.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join iflot                                on  iflot.tplnr = iloa.tplnr
    left outer join iflotx                               on  iflotx.tplnr = iloa.tplnr
                                                         and iflotx.spras = $session.system_language
    // ---- notification: malfunction / breakdown ----
    left outer join qmih                                 on  qmih.qmnum = afih.qmnum
    // ---- priority text ----
    left outer join t356_t                               on  t356_t.artpr = afih.artpr
                                                         and t356_t.priok = afih.priok
                                                         and t356_t.spras = $session.system_language
    // ---- system status (JEST) ----
    left outer join jest as StRel                        on  StRel.objnr = aufk.objnr
                                                         and StRel.stat  = 'I0002'     // REL
                                                         and StRel.inact = ''
    left outer join jest as StTeco                       on  StTeco.objnr = aufk.objnr
                                                         and StTeco.stat  = 'I0045'    // TECO
                                                         and StTeco.inact = ''
    left outer join jest as StClsd                       on  StClsd.objnr = aufk.objnr
                                                         and StClsd.stat  = 'I0046'    // CLSD
                                                         and StClsd.inact = ''
    left outer join jest as EqInac                       on  EqInac.objnr = equi.objnr
                                                         and EqInac.stat  = 'I0320'    // INAC (equipment)
                                                         and EqInac.inact = ''
    // ---- plant / cost center ----
    left outer join t001w                                on  t001w.werks = aufk.werks
    left outer join t005u                                on  t005u.spras = $session.system_language
                                                         and t005u.land1 = t001w.land1
                                                         and t005u.bland = t001w.regio
    left outer join t001k                                on  t001k.bwkey = t001w.bwkey
    left outer join csks                                 on  csks.kokrs = aufk.kokrs
                                                         and csks.kostl = aufk.kostl
                                                         and csks.datbi = '99991231'
    left outer join cskt                                 on  cskt.spras = $session.system_language
                                                         and cskt.kokrs = aufk.kokrs
                                                         and cskt.kostl = aufk.kostl
                                                         and cskt.datbi = '99991231'
    // ---- actual work ----
    left outer join ZI_ABC_OrderWorkAgg as Work          on  Work.MaintenanceOrder = aufk.aufnr
{
  key aufk.aufnr   as MaintenanceOrder,                 // AUFNR
      aufk.ktext   as OrderDescription,                 // KTEXT
      aufk.auart   as OrderType,                        // AUART (PM01/PM02/PM03)
      afih.ilart   as MaintenanceActivityType,          // ILART
      aufk.erdat   as OrderDate,                        // ERDAT
      afko.gstrp   as BasicStartDate,                   // GSTRP
      afko.gltrp   as BasicFinishDate,                  // GLTRP
      afko.getri   as ActualFinishDate,                 // GETRI

      // Maintenance Category - ASSUMPTION: order-type mapping, breakdown notification overrides
      cast( case when qmih.msaus = 'X'    then 'Breakdown'
                 when aufk.auart = 'PM01' then 'Corrective'
                 when aufk.auart = 'PM02' then 'Breakdown'
                 when aufk.auart = 'PM03' then 'Preventive'
                 else                          'Other' end as abap.char(15) ) as MaintenanceCategory,

      afih.priok   as Priority,                         // PRIOK
      t356_t.priokx as PriorityText,                    // PRIOKX

      cast( case when StClsd.stat is not null then 'Closed'
                 when StTeco.stat is not null then 'Completed'
                 when StRel.stat  is not null then 'In Progress'
                 else                              'Open' end as abap.char(15) ) as OrderStatus,

      // ---- Plant ----
      aufk.werks   as Plant,                            // WERKS
      t001w.name1  as PlantName,
      t001w.ort01  as City,
      t001w.regio  as State,
      t005u.bezei  as StateName,
      t001w.land1  as Country,
      t001k.bukrs  as CompanyCode,
      afih.iwerk   as PlanningPlant,                    // IWERK

      // ---- Functional location ----
      iloa.tplnr   as FunctionalLocation,               // TPLNR
      iflotx.pltxt as FunctionalLocationName,           // PLTXT
      iflot.tplma  as ParentFunctionalLocation,         // TPLMA

      // ---- Equipment ----
      afih.equnr   as Equipment,                        // EQUNR
      eqkt.eqktx   as EquipmentName,                    // EQKTX
      equi.eqart   as EquipmentCategory,                // EQART (object type)
      equi.herst   as Manufacturer,                     // HERST
      equi.inbdt   as InstallationDate,                 // INBDT
      cast( case when EqInac.stat is not null then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end
            as abap.char(10) )                          as EquipmentStatus,
      iloa.abckz   as ABCIndicator,                     // ABCKZ
      // Equipment Criticality - ASSUMPTION: ABC indicator A/B/C = High/Medium/Low
      cast( case iloa.abckz when 'A' then 'High'
                            when 'B' then 'Medium'
                            when 'C' then 'Low'
                            else          'Not Classified' end as abap.char(15) ) as EquipmentCriticality,

      // ---- Cost center ----
      aufk.kostl   as CostCenter,                       // KOSTL (responsible cost center)
      cskt.ktext   as CostCenterName,                   // KTEXT
      csks.abtei   as Department,                       // ABTEI
      csks.verak   as CostCenterManager,                // VERAK

      // ---- Notification / downtime ----
      afih.qmnum   as Notification,                     // QMNUM
      qmih.msaus   as BreakdownIndicator,               // MSAUS
      qmih.ausvn   as MalfunctionStartDate,             // AUSVN
      qmih.auztv   as MalfunctionStartTime,             // AUZTV
      qmih.ausbs   as MalfunctionEndDate,               // AUSBS
      qmih.auztb   as MalfunctionEndTime,               // AUZTB

      // ===== Measures =====
      coalesce( Work.ActualWorkHours, cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,2) ) )      as MaintenanceDurationHours,
      cast( case when qmih.ausvn <> '00000000' and qmih.ausbs <> '00000000'
                 then division( tstmp_seconds_between(
                                  dats_tims_to_tstmp( qmih.ausvn, qmih.auztv, 'UTC', $session.client, 'NULL' ),
                                  dats_tims_to_tstmp( qmih.ausbs, qmih.auztb, 'UTC', $session.client, 'NULL' ),
                                  'NULL' ), 3600, 2 )
                 else cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,2) ) end as abap.dec(15,2) ) as DowntimeHours,
      case when qmih.msaus = 'X' then 1 else 0 end                       as BreakdownCount,
      1                                                                  as MaintenanceOrderCount
}
where aufk.autyp = '30'          // maintenance orders

sqlDdl:
// Z_I_MATERIAL_MOVEMENT - grain: material document item (MATDOC), goods issues
// (261) and reversals (262) to maintenance orders.

@EndUserText.label: 'ABC: Maint. Material Consumption Fact'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #XXL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_ABC_MaterialMovementFact
  as select from matdoc
    inner join      aufk on  aufk.aufnr = matdoc.aufnr
                         and aufk.autyp = '30'
    inner join      afih on  afih.aufnr = matdoc.aufnr
    left outer join mara on  mara.matnr = matdoc.matnr
    left outer join makt on  makt.matnr = matdoc.matnr
                         and makt.spras = $session.system_language
{
  key matdoc.mblnr  as MaterialDocument,                // MBLNR
  key matdoc.mjahr  as MaterialDocumentYear,            // MJAHR
  key matdoc.zeile  as MaterialDocumentItem,            // ZEILE
      matdoc.aufnr  as MaintenanceOrder,                // AUFNR
      aufk.auart    as OrderType,                       // AUART
      afih.equnr    as Equipment,                       // EQUNR (order's equipment)
      matdoc.bwart  as MovementType,                    // BWART
      matdoc.budat  as PostingDate,                     // BUDAT
      matdoc.werks  as Plant,                           // WERKS
      matdoc.lgort  as StorageLocation,                 // LGORT
      matdoc.matnr  as Material,                        // MATNR
      makt.maktx    as MaterialDescription,             // MAKTX
      mara.mtart    as MaterialType,                    // MTART
      mara.matkl    as MaterialGroup,                   // MATKL
      matdoc.meins  as Unit,                            // MEINS
      matdoc.waers  as Currency,                        // WAERS

      // Issues positive, reversals (262) negative
      cast( case when matdoc.bwart = '262' then cast( matdoc.menge as abap.dec(15,3) ) * -1
                 else                            cast( matdoc.menge as abap.dec(15,3) ) end
            as abap.dec(15,3) )                         as Quantity,
      cast( case when matdoc.bwart = '262' then cast( matdoc.dmbtr as abap.dec(17,2) ) * -1
                 else                            cast( matdoc.dmbtr as abap.dec(17,2) ) end
            as abap.dec(17,2) )                         as MaterialValue
}
where matdoc.record_type = 'MDOC'
  and ( matdoc.bwart = '261' or matdoc.bwart = '262' )

define view entity ZI_BillingItem
  as select from    vbrp  as item

    inner join      vbrk  as head on item.vbeln = head.vbeln

    inner join      vbkd  as bus  on item.aubel = bus.vbeln

    left outer join t171t as dist on  dist.bzirk = bus.bzirk
                                  and dist.spras = 'E'

{

      head.fkdat,

      item.vbtyp_ana,

}
where
      head.fkart <> 'ZSTO'
  and head.fkart <> 'ZST1'
  and head.fkart <> 'ZST2'
  and head.fkart <> 'ZST3'
  and head.fkart <> 'S1'
  and head.fkart <> 'ZMSR'

sqlDdl:
// FACT_GOODS_MOVEMENT - grain: material document item.
// AUFM/MSEG are compatibility views on MATDOC in S/4HANA, so MATDOC is read directly.
// MovementCategory keeps vendor 101 and production 101 apart.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'MYQ: Goods Movement Fact (MATDOC 101/261/551)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #XXL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_MYQ_GoodsMovementFact
  as select from matdoc
    left outer join mcha on  mcha.matnr = matdoc.matnr
                         and mcha.werks = matdoc.werks
                         and mcha.charg = matdoc.charg
    left outer join makt on  makt.matnr = matdoc.matnr
                         and makt.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join lfa1  on  lfa1.lifnr  = matdoc.lifnr                     
{
  key matdoc.mblnr  as MaterialDocument,                    // MBLNR
  key matdoc.mjahr  as MaterialDocumentYear,                // MJAHR
  key matdoc.zeile  as MaterialDocumentItem,                // ZEILE
      matdoc.budat  as PostingDate,                         // BUDAT
      matdoc.bwart  as MovementType,                        // BWART
      matdoc.kzbew  as MovementIndicator,                   // KZBEW (F = order, B = PO)
      cast( case
              when ( matdoc.bwart = '101' or matdoc.bwart = '102' ) and matdoc.kzbew = 'F' then 'Production GR'
              when ( matdoc.bwart = '101' or matdoc.bwart = '102' ) and matdoc.kzbew = 'B' then 'Purchase GR'
              when   matdoc.bwart = '101' or matdoc.bwart = '102'                          then 'Other GR'
              when   matdoc.bwart = '261' or matdoc.bwart = '262'                          then 'Consumption'
              else                                                                              'Scrap'
            end as abap.char(20) )                          as MovementCategory,
      matdoc.matnr  as Material,                            // MATNR
      makt.maktx    as MaterialName,                        // MAKTX
      matdoc.werks  as Plant,                               // WERKS
      matdoc.lgort  as StorageLocation,                     // LGORT
      matdoc.charg  as Batch,                               // CHARG
      matdoc.aufnr  as ProductionOrder,                     // AUFNR
      matdoc.ebeln  as PurchaseOrder,                       // EBELN
      matdoc.lifnr  as Supplier,                            // LIFNR (on PO receipts)
      mcha.lifnr    as BatchSupplier,                       // MCHA-LIFNR (vendor of the batch)
      mcha.licha    as SupplierBatch,                       // MCHA-LICHA
      mcha.hsdat    as ManufactureDate,                     // MCHA-HSDAT
      mcha.vfdat    as ShelfLifeExpirationDate,             // MCHA-VFDAT
      matdoc.meins  as BaseUnit,                            // MEINS
      matdoc.cpudt  as EntryDate,                       // CPUDT
      matdoc.usnam  as EnteredBy,                       // USNAM
      mcha.ersda    as BatchCreatedOn,                  // ERSDA
      mcha.ernam    as BatchCreatedBy,                  // ERNAM
      lfa1.ort01    as SupplierCity,                    // ORT01
      lfa1.land1    as SupplierCountry,                 // LAND1
      lfa1.name1    as SupplierName,                    // NAME1
      // Positive for 101/261/551, negative for reversals 102/262/552
      cast( case when matdoc.bwart = '102' or matdoc.bwart = '262' or matdoc.bwart = '552'
                 then cast( matdoc.menge as abap.dec(15,3) ) * -1
                 else cast( matdoc.menge as abap.dec(15,3) ) end
            as abap.dec(15,3) )                             as MovementQuantity
}
where matdoc.record_type = 'MDOC'
  and ( matdoc.bwart = '101' or matdoc.bwart = '102'
     or matdoc.bwart = '261' or matdoc.bwart = '262'
     or matdoc.bwart = '551' or matdoc.bwart = '552' )

name: ZI_MYQ_INSPECTIONLOTFACT
sqlDdl:
// Inspection lot grain (PRUEFLOS). Lot quantity appears exactly once here,
// so this is the view to SUM inspection quantity from.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'MYQ: Inspection Lot Fact (QALS + UD)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #B, sizeCategory: #L, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_MYQ_InspectionLotFact
  as select from qals
    left outer join ZI_MYQ_UsageDecisionLatest as UDLast on  UDLast.InspectionLot = qals.prueflos
    left outer join qave                                 on  qave.prueflos = UDLast.InspectionLot
                                                         and qave.kzart    = 'L'
                                                         and qave.zaehler  = UDLast.LatestCounter
    left outer join makt                                 on  makt.matnr = qals.matnr
                                                         and makt.spras = $session.system_language
{
  key qals.prueflos   as InspectionLot,                     // PRUEFLOS
      qals.art        as InspectionType,                    // ART
      qals.herkunft   as InspectionLotOrigin,               // HERKUNFT
      cast( case qals.herkunft when '01' then 'Incoming (GR)'
                               when '03' then 'In-Process (Production)'
                               when '04' then 'Final (GR from Production)'
                               else           'Other' end as abap.char(30) ) as InspectionStage,
      qals.werk       as Plant,                             // WERK
      qals.matnr      as Material,                          // MATNR
      makt.maktx      as MaterialName,
      qals.charg      as Batch,                             // CHARG
      qals.aufnr      as ProductionOrder,                   // AUFNR (production lots)
      qals.ebeln      as PurchaseOrder,                     // EBELN (GR lots)
      qals.ebelp      as PurchaseOrderItem,                 // EBELP (spec R02: PO + item, not PO alone)
      qals.mblnr      as GRMaterialDocument,                // MBLNR (goods receipt that created the lot)
      qals.mjahr      as GRMaterialDocumentYear,            // MJAHR
      qals.zeile      as GRMaterialDocumentItem,            // ZEILE
      qals.lifnr      as Supplier,                          // LIFNR
      qals.enstehdat  as LotCreationDate,                   // ENSTEHDAT
      qals.pastrterm  as InspectionStartDate,               // PASTRTERM
      qals.paendterm  as InspectionEndDate,                 // PAENDTERM
      qals.mengeneinh as LotUnit,                           // MENGENEINH
      cast( qals.losmenge as abap.dec(15,3) ) as InspectionLotQuantity,  // LOSMENGE

      // Usage decision
      qave.vcodegrp   as UsageDecisionCodeGroup,            // VCODEGRP
      qave.vcode      as UsageDecisionCode,                 // VCODE
      qave.vbewertung as UsageDecisionValuation,            // VBEWERTUNG (A / R)
      cast( case when qave.vbewertung = 'A' then 'Accepted'
                 when qave.vbewertung = 'R' then 'Rejected'
                 else                            'Open' end as abap.char(10) ) as UsageDecisionStatus,
      qave.vdatum     as UsageDecisionDate,                 // VDATUM
      qave.vname      as UsageDecisionBy,                   // VNAME
      qals.stat01     as LotStatus01,                       // STAT01     

      // Counters for KPIs
      1                                                 as InspectionLotCount,
      case when qave.vbewertung = 'R' then 1 else 0 end as RejectedLotCount
}
/*+[internal] {

name: ZI_MYQ_INSPECTIONRESULTFACT
sqlDdl:
// FACT_INSPECTION_RESULT - grain: inspection lot + operation + characteristic.
// Lot quantity repeats on every characteristic row -> attribute only, never SUM it.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'MYQ: Inspection Result Fact (QAMR/QAMV)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #B, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_MYQ_InspectionResultFact
  as select from qamr
    inner join      qamv                                 on  qamv.prueflos = qamr.prueflos
                                                         and qamv.vorglfnr = qamr.vorglfnr
                                                         and qamv.merknr   = qamr.merknr
    inner join      ZI_MYQ_InspectionLotFact   as Lot    on  Lot.InspectionLot = qamr.prueflos
{
  key qamr.prueflos   as InspectionLot,                     // PRUEFLOS
  key qamr.vorglfnr   as InspectionOperation,               // VORGLFNR
  key qamr.merknr     as InspectionCharacteristic,          // MERKNR
      qamv.verwmerkm  as MasterCharacteristic,              // VERWMERKM
      qamv.kurztext   as CharacteristicText,                // KURZTEXT
      qamv.masseinhsw as CharacteristicUnit,                // MASSEINHSW
      qamv.sollwert   as TargetValue,                       // SOLLWERT
      qamv.toleranzun as LowerToleranceLimit,               // TOLERANZUN
      qamv.toleranzob as UpperToleranceLimit,               // TOLERANZOB
      qamr.mittelwert as MeasuredValue,                     // MITTELWERT (mean of recorded values)
      qamr.anzwertg   as NumberOfValuesRecorded,            // ANZWERTG
      qamr.mbewertg   as CharacteristicValuation,           // MBEWERTG (A / R)
      qamr.satzstatus as ResultRecordStatus,                // SATZSTATUS
      cast( qamr.anzfehler as abap.dec(15,3) ) as NumberOfDefects,     // ANZFEHLER
      
      cast( case qamr.mbewertg when 'A' then 'Accepted'
                               when 'R' then 'Rejected'
                               else          'Not Valuated' end as abap.char(15) ) as ResultStatus,
      Lot.InspectionStage,
      Lot.Plant,
      Lot.Material,
      Lot.MaterialName,
      Lot.Batch,
      Lot.ProductionOrder,
      Lot.Supplier,
      Lot.LotCreationDate,
      Lot.InspectionLotQuantity,                            // attribute only - do not SUM
      Lot.LotUnit,
      Lot.UsageDecisionCode,
      Lot.UsageDecisionStatus,
      Lot.UsageDecisionDate,
      1 as ResultCount,
      case when qamr.mbewertg = 'R' then 1 else 0 end as RejectedResultCount
}

sqlDdl:
// FACT_PRODUCTION_CONFIRMATION - grain: one confirmation (RUECK + RMZHL)
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'MYQ: Production Confirmation Fact (AFRU)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_MYQ_ProdConfirmationFact
  as select from afru
    inner join      afko                                 on  afko.aufnr = afru.aufnr
    inner join      aufk                                 on  aufk.aufnr = afru.aufnr
    inner join      afpo                                 on  afpo.aufnr = afru.aufnr
                                                         and afpo.posnr = '0001'
    left outer join makt                                 on  makt.matnr = afpo.matnr
                                                         and makt.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join afvc                                 on  afvc.aufpl = afru.aufpl
                                                         and afvc.aplzl = afru.aplzl
    left outer join crhd                                 on  crhd.objty = 'A'
                                                         and crhd.objid = afru.arbid
    left outer join crtx                                 on  crtx.objty = 'A'
                                                         and crtx.objid = afru.arbid
                                                         and crtx.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join ZI_MYQ_OrderLastOperation as LastOp  on  LastOp.RoutingNumber = afru.aufpl
    left outer join ZI_MYQ_WorkCenterCostCenter as WcCc    on  WcCc.ObjectType           = 'A'
                                                           and WcCc.WorkCenterInternalID = afru.arbid
    left outer join tc37t                                  on  tc37t.spras    = $session.system_language
                                                           and tc37t.schgrup  = afru.schgrup
                                                           and tc37t.kaptprog = afru.kaptprog
    left outer join tc37a                                  on  tc37a.schgrup  = afru.schgrup
                                                           and tc37a.kaptprog = afru.kaptprog
                                                           and tc37a.endda    = '99991231'
    left outer join t001w                                on  t001w.werks = afru.werks                                                       
{
  key afru.rueck  as Confirmation,                          // RUECK
  key afru.rmzhl  as ConfirmationCounter,                   // RMZHL
      afru.aufnr  as ProductionOrder,                       // AUFNR
      afru.vornr  as Operation,                             // VORNR
      afvc.ltxa1  as OperationText,                         // LTXA1
      aufk.auart  as OrderType,                             // AUART
      afpo.matnr  as Material,                              // MATNR (produced material)
      makt.maktx  as MaterialName,                          // MAKTX
      afpo.charg  as Batch,                                 // CHARG
      afru.werks  as Plant,                                 // WERKS
      crhd.arbpl  as WorkCenter,                            // CRHD-ARBPL (via AFRU-ARBID)
      crtx.ktext  as WorkCenterName,                        // CRTX-KTEXT
      afru.budat  as PostingDate,                           // BUDAT
      afru.isdd   as ExecutionStartDate,                    // ISDD
      afru.isdz   as ExecutionStartTime,                    // ISDZ
      afru.aueru  as IsFinalConfirmation,                   // AUERU
      afru.ernam  as ConfirmedByUser,                       // ERNAM
            aufk.autyp   as OrderCategory,                    // AUTYP
      aufk.refnr   as ReferenceOrder,                   // REFNR
      aufk.erdat   as OrderCreatedOn,                   // ERDAT
      afko.gstrp   as BasicStartDate,                   // GSTRP
      afko.gltrp   as BasicFinishDate,                  // GLTRP
      afpo.posnr   as OrderItem,                        // POSNR
      afko.stlnr   as BillOfMaterial,                   // AFKO-STLNR (spec: AFPO-BOMNR - not on S21)
      afko.stlal   as BOMAlternative,                   // AFKO-STLAL
      afpo.pwerk   as PlanningPlant,                    // PWERK
      afpo.meins   as OrderUnit,                        // MEINS
      crhd.verwe   as WorkCenterCategory,               // VERWE
      crhd.begda   as WorkCenterValidFrom,              // BEGDA
      crhd.endda   as WorkCenterValidTo,                // ENDDA
      crhd.lvorm   as WorkCenterDeletionFlag,           // LVORM
      WcCc.CostCenter as WorkCenterCostCenter,          // CRCO-KOSTL
      afru.schgrup as ShiftGrouping,                    // SCHGRUP
      afru.kaptprog as ShiftSequence,                   // KAPTPROG
      tc37t.ktext  as ShiftText,                        // TC37T-KTEXT
      tc37a.begzt  as ShiftStartTime,                   // TC37A-BEGZT
      tc37a.endzt  as ShiftEndTime,                     // TC37A-ENDZT
      t001w.regio  as PlantRegion,
      t001w.bwkey  as ValuationArea,
      t001w.fabkl  as FactoryCalendar,
      cast( afpo.psmng as abap.dec(15,3) ) as OrderQuantity,        // PSMNG
      cast( afko.gasmg as abap.dec(15,3) ) as PlannedScrapQuantity, // GASMG
      case when afru.gmein = afpo.meins then 0 else 1 end as IsUnitDifferentFromOrder,

      // Shift derived from execution start time.
      // ASSUMPTION: A 06-14, B 14-22, C 22-06 - replace with the client's shift pattern.
      cast( case when afru.isdz >= '060000' and afru.isdz < '140000' then 'A'
                 when afru.isdz >= '140000' and afru.isdz < '220000' then 'B'
                 else 'C' end as abap.char(1) )                          as Shift,
      cast( case when afru.isdz >= '060000' and afru.isdz < '140000' then 'Morning'
                 when afru.isdz >= '140000' and afru.isdz < '220000' then 'Evening'
                 else 'Night' end as abap.char(10) )                     as ShiftName,

      // 1 = confirmation of the last operation -> use for order yield
      case when afru.vornr = LastOp.LastOperation then 1 else 0 end      as IsLastOperation,

      afru.gmein  as QuantityUnit,                          // GMEIN
      cast( afru.lmnga as abap.dec(15,3) ) as ConfirmedYieldQuantity,   // LMNGA
      cast( afru.xmnga as abap.dec(15,3) ) as ConfirmedScrapQuantity,   // XMNGA
      cast( afru.rmnga as abap.dec(15,3) ) as ConfirmedReworkQuantity,  // RMNGA
      cast( afko.gamng as abap.dec(15,3) ) as OrderTargetQuantity,      // GAMNG - attribute only, do not SUM
      1                                    as ConfirmationCount
}
where ( aufk.autyp = '10' or aufk.autyp = '40' )   // production / process orders
  and afru.stokz = ''                               // not a reversed confirmation
  and afru.stzhl = '00000000'                       // not a cancellation record

sqlDdl:
// FACT_QUALITY_DEFECT - grain: notification defect item (QMNUM + FENUM)
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'MYQ: Quality Defect Fact (QMEL/QMFE/QMUR)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #B, sizeCategory: #L, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_MYQ_QualityDefectFact
  as select from qmfe
    inner join      qmel                                 on  qmel.qmnum = qmfe.qmnum
    left outer join ZI_MYQ_DefectFirstCause   as FC      on  FC.QualityNotification = qmfe.qmnum
                                                         and FC.DefectItem          = qmfe.fenum
    left outer join qmur                                 on  qmur.qmnum = FC.QualityNotification
                                                         and qmur.fenum = FC.DefectItem
                                                         and qmur.urnum = FC.FirstCauseNumber
    left outer join makt                                 on  makt.matnr = qmel.matnr
                                                         and makt.spras = $session.system_language
{
  key qmfe.qmnum    as QualityNotification,                 // QMNUM
  key qmfe.fenum    as DefectItem,                          // FENUM (spec: QMPOS)
      qmel.qmart    as NotificationType,                    // QMART
      qmel.qmtxt    as NotificationText,                    // QMTXT
      qmel.erdat    as NotificationDate,                    // ERDAT
      qmel.mawerk   as Plant,                               // MAWERK
      qmel.matnr    as Material,                            // MATNR
      makt.maktx    as MaterialName,
      qmel.charg    as Batch,                               // CHARG
      qmel.aufnr    as ProductionOrder,                     // AUFNR
      qmel.prueflos as InspectionLot,                       // PRUEFLOS (controlled lot link)
      qmel.lifnum   as Supplier,                            // LIFNUM

      // Defect (spec: SCHADEN)
      qmfe.fegrp    as DefectCodeGroup,                     // FEGRP
      qmfe.fecod    as DefectCode,                          // FECOD
      // Cause (spec: URSACH) - causes live in QMUR, not QMFE
      qmur.urgrp    as CauseCodeGroup,                      // URGRP
      qmur.urcod    as CauseCode,                           // URCOD
      qmfe.fetxt    as DefectText,                          // FETXT
      qmur.urtxt    as CauseText,                           // QMUR-URTXT      
      // Impact (spec: AUSWIRK) - mapped to defect class (critical/major/minor)
      qmfe.feqklas  as DefectClass,                         // FEQKLAS

      qmel.mgein    as DefectQuantityUnit,                  // MGEIN
      cast( qmfe.anzfehler as abap.dec(15,3) ) as NumberOfDefects,     // ANZFEHLER
      cast( qmfe.fmgeig    as abap.dec(15,3) ) as DefectQuantity,      // FMGEIG (defective qty, internal)
      1 as DefectItemCount
}
where qmfe.kzloesch = ''

sqlDdl:
// 01_MASTER_FACT_O2C - grain: Sales Document + Sales Document Item.
// Customer-level credit fields repeat per item -> use customer exception aggregation.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'O2C: Master Fact'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #D, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #MIXED }
define view entity ZI_O2C_MasterFact
  as select from ZI_O2C_MasterFactBase as B
{
      // ===== Sales order =====
  key B.SalesDocument,
  key B.SalesDocumentItem,
      cast( concat( concat( B.SalesDocument, '-' ), B.SalesDocumentItem ) as abap.char(17) ) as TechnicalRowKey,
      B.SalesDocumentType,
      B.OrderDate,
      B.RequestedDeliveryDate,
      B.Customer,
      B.SalesOrganization,
      B.DistributionChannel,
      B.CompanyCode,
      B.Currency,
      B.ReportingCurrency,
      cast( case B.OverallStatus when 'A' then 'Open'
                                 when 'B' then 'In Process'
                                 when 'C' then 'Completed'
                                 else          'Not Relevant' end as abap.char(15) ) as OrderStatus,
      B.RejectionReason,
      B.Material,
      B.ItemDescription,
      B.SalesUnit,
      B.PriceUnit,
      B.PriceUnitOfMeasure,
      B.OrderQuantity,
      B.OrderItemNetValue,

      // ===== Delivery =====
      B.Delivery,
      B.DeliveryItem,
      B.DeliveryDate,
      B.ActualGoodsIssueDate,
      B.ShipFromPlant,
      B.ShipFromPlant                        as ReceivingPlant,   // same plant (LIPS-WERKS) - see notes
      B.ShippingPoint,
      B.DeliveredQuantity,
      B.OrderToDeliveryDays,
      cast( case when B.IsOnTime = 1 and B.IsInFull = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as abap.char(1) ) as OTIFFlag,
      cast( case when B.DeliveredQuantity <= 0 then 'Not Delivered'
                 when B.IsInFull = 1          then 'Fully Delivered'
                 else                              'Partially Delivered' end as abap.char(20) ) as DeliveryStatus,

      // ===== Billing / revenue =====
      B.BillingDocument,
      B.BillingDate,
      B.InvoicedQuantity,
      B.BillingItemNetValue,
      B.DeliveryToBillingDays,
      cast( case when B.BillingDocument is null                    then 'Not Billed'
                 when B.InvoicedQuantity >= B.OrderQuantity         then 'Fully Billed'
                 else                                                    'Partially Billed' end as abap.char(20) ) as BillingStatus,
      B.RevenueCategory,
      B.RevenueInCCCrcy                      as TotalRevenue,       // net revenue, company code currency

      // ===== FI / AR =====
      B.FIDocumentNumber,
      B.FiscalYear,
      B.PostingDate,
      B.DocumentDate,
      B.FIDocumentType,
      B.DebitCreditCode,
      B.AmountInLocalCurrency,                                     // FI receivable (incl. tax), allocated to item
      B.BaselinePaymentDate,
      B.DueDate,
      B.OpenAmount,
      B.ARStatus,
      B.ClearingDate,
      B.DaysOutstanding,
      cast( case when B.ARStatus = 'Not Invoiced' or B.ARStatus = 'Not Posted' then 'Not Applicable'
                 when B.ARStatus = 'Cleared' then 'Cleared'
                 when B.DaysPastDue <= 0     then 'Current/Not Due'
                 when B.DaysPastDue <= 30    then '1-30'
                 when B.DaysPastDue <= 60    then '31-60'
                 when B.DaysPastDue <= 90    then '61-90'
                 else                             '90+' end as abap.char(15) ) as AgeBucket,
     // cast( case when B.ARStatus = 'Open' and B.ExpectedCollectionDate < $session.system_date
                 //then 'Y' else 'N' end as abap.char(1) )                      as PastDueFlag,
     // B.ExpectedCollectionDate,
     // cast( case when B.ARStatus = 'Cleared' then substring( B.ClearingDate, 1, 6 )
                // when B.ARStatus = 'Open'    then substring( B.ExpectedCollectionDate, 1, 6 )
                // else                             'NONE' end as abap.char(6) ) as CashCollectionMonth,   // YYYYMM
      B.DaysToClear,
      B.BillingToCollectionDays,

      // ===== Customer / credit / collections =====
      B.CustomerName,
      B.CustomerCountry,
      B.CustomerCity,
      B.CustomerRegion,
      B.CustomerGroup,
      B.CustomerAcctAssignmentGroup,
      B.PaymentTerms,
      B.AvgPaymentDelayDays,
      B.DunningLevel,
      B.LastDunningDate,
      B.RiskClass,
      B.CreditExposure                        as TotalCreditExposure,   // customer-level: exception aggregation
      B.CreditLimit,                                                    // customer-level: exception aggregation
      B.CreditUtilizationPercent,                                       // do not SUM
      cast( case when B.CreditLimit > 0 and B.CreditExposure > B.CreditLimit
                 then 'Y' else 'N' end as abap.char(1) )                 as OverCreditLimit,
      cast( case when B.CreditLimit > 0 and B.CreditUtilizationPercent > 80
                 then 'Y' else 'N' end as abap.char(1) )                 as Above80PctCreditLimit,
      cast( case when B.IsCreditBlocked = 'X' or B.CustomerOrderBlock <> ''
                 then 'Y' else 'N' end as abap.char(1) )                 as CustomerBlocked,
      // Open AR of this item where the customer is over limit / blocked, or the item is 90+ days overdue
      cast( case when B.OpenAmount <> 0
                  and ( ( B.CreditLimit > 0 and B.CreditExposure > B.CreditLimit )
                     or B.IsCreditBlocked = 'X'
                     or B.DaysPastDue > 90 )
                 then B.OpenAmount else cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) end as abap.dec(17,2) ) as RevenueAtRisk,

      // ===== Material =====
      B.ProductName,
      B.ProductDivision,
      B.ProfitCenter,
      B.HomePlantCode,
      B.HomePlantName,
      B.StandardPrice,
      B.StandardPriceUnit,
      B.UnitOfMeasure,

      // ===== Plant / company =====
      B.ShipFromPlantName,
      B.ShipFromPlantName                     as ReceivingPlantName,
      B.PlantRegion,
      B.PlantCompany,
      B.PlantCompanyName,
      B.CompanyName,
      B.CompanyCountry,

      // ===== Counters =====
      1 as SalesItemCount
}

name: ZI_O2C_MASTERFACTBASE
sqlDdl:
// O2C fact - step 1: sales order item enriched with delivery, billing, AR,
// customer, material, plant and credit. Every join is to-one.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'O2C: Master Fact Base (enriched)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #D, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #MIXED }
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@Analytics.dataExtraction.delta.changeDataCapture.automatic: true
define view entity ZI_O2C_MasterFactBase
  as select from vbap
    inner join      vbak                                 on  vbak.vbeln = vbap.vbeln
    // ---- process helpers ----
    left outer join ZI_O2C_DeliveryAgg       as Dlv      on  Dlv.SalesOrder     = vbap.vbeln
                                                         and Dlv.SalesOrderItem = vbap.posnr
    left outer join ZI_O2C_BillingAgg        as Bil      on  Bil.SalesOrder     = vbap.vbeln
                                                         and Bil.SalesOrderItem = vbap.posnr
    left outer join ZI_O2C_InvoiceAR         as AR       on  AR.BillingDocument = Bil.LatestBillingDocument
    left outer join ZI_O2C_CustomerCredit    as Cred     on  Cred.Customer = vbak.kunnr
    // ---- customer ----
    left outer join kna1                                 on  kna1.kunnr = vbak.kunnr
    left outer join knvv                                 on  knvv.kunnr = vbak.kunnr
                                                         and knvv.vkorg = vbak.vkorg
                                                         and knvv.vtweg = vbak.vtweg
                                                         and knvv.spart = vbak.spart
    left outer join knb1                                 on  knb1.kunnr = vbak.kunnr
                                                         and knb1.bukrs = vbak.bukrs_vf
    left outer join t052                                 on  t052.zterm = knb1.zterm
                                                         and t052.ztagg = '00'
    // ---- company / material / plant ----
    left outer join t001                     as Co       on  Co.bukrs = vbak.bukrs_vf
    left outer join mara                                 on  mara.matnr = vbap.matnr
    left outer join makt                                 on  makt.matnr = vbap.matnr
                                                         and makt.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join mbew                                 on  mbew.matnr = vbap.matnr
                                                         and mbew.bwkey = vbap.werks
                                                         and mbew.bwtar = ''
    left outer join t001w                    as HomePl   on  HomePl.werks = vbap.werks
    left outer join t001w                    as ShipPl   on  ShipPl.werks = Dlv.ShipFromPlant
    left outer join t001k                    as ShipVa   on  ShipVa.bwkey = ShipPl.bwkey
    left outer join t001                     as ShipCo   on  ShipCo.bukrs = ShipVa.bukrs
{
  key vbap.vbeln   as SalesDocument,                    // VBELN
  key vbap.posnr   as SalesDocumentItem,                // POSNR

      // ---- Sales order ----
      vbak.auart   as SalesDocumentType,                // AUART
      vbak.erdat   as OrderDate,                        // ERDAT (created on)
      vbak.vdatu   as RequestedDeliveryDate,            // VDATU
      vbak.kunnr   as Customer,                         // KUNNR (sold-to)
      vbak.vkorg   as SalesOrganization,                // VKORG
      vbak.vtweg   as DistributionChannel,              // VTWEG
      vbak.bukrs_vf as CompanyCode,                     // BUKRS_VF
      vbak.waerk   as Currency,                         // WAERK
      Co.waers     as ReportingCurrency,                // company code currency
      vbak.gbstk   as OverallStatus,                    // GBSTK
      vbap.abgru   as RejectionReason,                  // ABGRU
      vbap.matnr   as Material,                         // MATNR
      vbap.arktx   as ItemDescription,                  // ARKTX
      vbap.vrkme   as SalesUnit,
      vbap.kpein   as PriceUnit,                        // KPEIN (condition pricing unit)
      vbap.kmein   as PriceUnitOfMeasure,               // KMEIN                        // VRKME
      cast( vbap.kwmeng as abap.dec(15,3) ) as OrderQuantity,        // KWMENG
      cast( vbap.netwr  as abap.dec(17,2) ) as OrderItemNetValue,    // NETWR (doc currency)

      // ---- Delivery ----
      Dlv.LatestDelivery      as Delivery,
      Dlv.LatestDeliveryItem  as DeliveryItem,
      Dlv.DeliveryDate,
      Dlv.ActualGoodsIssueDate,
      Dlv.ShipFromPlant,
      Dlv.ShippingPoint,
      Dlv.DeliveryCount,
      coalesce( Dlv.DeliveredQuantity, cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) ) as DeliveredQuantity,
      case when Dlv.DeliveredQuantity >= cast( vbap.kwmeng as abap.dec(15,3) ) then 1 else 0 end as IsInFull,
      case when Dlv.ActualGoodsIssueDate is null or Dlv.ActualGoodsIssueDate = '00000000' then 0
           when vbak.vdatu = '00000000'                                  then 0
           when Dlv.ActualGoodsIssueDate <= vbak.vdatu                   then 1
           else 0 end                                                    as IsOnTime,
      case when Dlv.DeliveryDate is null or Dlv.DeliveryDate < vbak.erdat then 0
           else dats_days_between( vbak.erdat, Dlv.DeliveryDate ) end    as OrderToDeliveryDays,

      // ---- Billing ----
      Bil.LatestBillingDocument  as BillingDocument,
      Bil.LastBillingDate        as BillingDate,
      Bil.BillingDocumentCount,
      Bil.RevenueCategory,
      coalesce( Bil.InvoicedQuantity,   cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) ) as InvoicedQuantity,
      coalesce( Bil.BilledNetValue,     cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as BillingItemNetValue,
      coalesce( Bil.RevenueInCCCrcy,    cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as RevenueInCCCrcy,
      coalesce( Bil.ARAmountInCCCrcy,   cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as AmountInLocalCurrency,
      coalesce( Bil.OpenAmountInCCCrcy, cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as OpenAmount,
      case when Bil.LastBillingDate is null or Dlv.DeliveryDate is null
             or Bil.LastBillingDate < Dlv.DeliveryDate                  then 0
           else dats_days_between( Dlv.DeliveryDate, Bil.LastBillingDate ) end as DeliveryToBillingDays,

      // ---- FI / AR (latest valid invoice) ----
      AR.AccountingDocument      as FIDocumentNumber,
      AR.FiscalYear,
      AR.PostingDate,
      AR.DocumentDate,
      AR.DocumentType            as FIDocumentType,
      AR.DebitCreditCode,
      AR.BaselineDate            as BaselinePaymentDate,
      AR.NetDueDate              as DueDate,
      AR.ClearingDate,
      AR.DunningLevel,
      AR.LastDunnedDate          as LastDunningDate,
      cast( case when Bil.LatestBillingDocument is null then 'Not Invoiced'
                 when AR.BillingDocument is null           then 'Not Posted'
                 when AR.OpenLineCount > 0                 then 'Open'
                 else                                           'Cleared' end as abap.char(15) ) as ARStatus,
      case when AR.OpenLineCount > 0
           then dats_days_between( AR.NetDueDate, $session.system_date ) else 0 end            as DaysPastDue,
      case when AR.BillingDocument is null then 0
           when AR.OpenLineCount > 0 and AR.PostingDate <= $session.system_date
                then dats_days_between( AR.PostingDate, $session.system_date )
           when AR.OpenLineCount = 0 and AR.PostingDate <= AR.ClearingDate
                then dats_days_between( AR.PostingDate, AR.ClearingDate )
           else 0 end                                                                          as DaysOutstanding,
      case when AR.BillingDocument is not null and AR.OpenLineCount = 0
            and AR.PostingDate <= AR.ClearingDate
           then dats_days_between( AR.PostingDate, AR.ClearingDate ) else 0 end                as DaysToClear,
      case when AR.BillingDocument is not null and AR.OpenLineCount = 0
            and Bil.LastBillingDate <= AR.ClearingDate
           then dats_days_between( Bil.LastBillingDate, AR.ClearingDate ) else 0 end           as BillingToCollectionDays,
      // Cleared = clearing date; open = net due date; not invoiced = order date + customer terms
//case when AR.BillingDocument is not null and AR.OpenLineCount = 0 then AR.ClearingDate
 //    when AR.BillingDocument is not null                        then AR.NetDueDate
 //    else dats_add_days( vbak.erdat,
 //                        case when t052.ztag3 > '000' then cast( t052.ztag3 as abap.int4 )
  //                            when t052.ztag2 > '000' then cast( t052.ztag2 as abap.int4 )
 //                             else                         cast( t052.ztag1 as abap.int4 )
 //                        end,
 //                        'INITIAL' )
//end                                                             as ExpectedCollectionDate,                                                                                     as ExpectedCollectionDate,

      // ---- Customer ----
      kna1.name1   as CustomerName,                     // NAME1
      kna1.land1   as CustomerCountry,                  // LAND1
      kna1.ort01   as CustomerCity,                     // ORT01
      kna1.regio   as CustomerRegion,                   // REGIO
      kna1.aufsd   as CustomerOrderBlock,               // AUFSD
      knvv.kdgrp   as CustomerGroup,                    // KDGRP
      knvv.ktgrd   as CustomerAcctAssignmentGroup,      // KTGRD
      coalesce( AR.PaymentTerms, knb1.zterm ) as PaymentTerms,   // invoice terms, else KNB1-ZTERM
      Cred.AvgPaymentDelayDays,
      Cred.RiskClass,
      Cred.IsCreditBlocked,
      Cred.CreditLimit,
      Cred.CreditExposure,
      Cred.CreditUtilizationPercent,

      // ---- Material ----
      makt.maktx   as ProductName,                      // MAKTX
      mara.spart   as ProductDivision,                  // SPART
      mara.meins   as UnitOfMeasure,                    // MEINS
      vbap.prctr   as ProfitCenter,                     // PRCTR
      vbap.werks   as HomePlantCode,                    // WERKS (order item plant)
      HomePl.name1 as HomePlantName,
      cast( mbew.stprs as abap.dec(17,2) ) as StandardPrice,     // STPRS (per PEINH)
      mbew.peinh   as StandardPriceUnit,                // PEINH

      // ---- Plant / company ----
      ShipPl.name1 as ShipFromPlantName,
      ShipPl.regio as PlantRegion,
      ShipVa.bukrs as PlantCompany,
      ShipCo.butxt as PlantCompanyName,
      Co.butxt     as CompanyName,
      Co.land1     as CompanyCountry
}
where vbak.vbtyp = 'C'          // sales orders

sqlDdl:
// 01_MASTER_FACT_OPEX - grain: Accounting Document + Line Item (ACDOCA, ledger 0L).
// Only documents with at least one expense line; all lines of those documents
// are kept (expense debit + payables credit). OPEX Flag / Group / Category /
// Subcategory and OPEX Amount are added in Datasphere via the G/L mapping table.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'OPEX: Master Fact'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_OPX_MasterFact
  as select from acdoca
    inner join      ZI_OPX_DocumentSummary as Doc  on  Doc.CompanyCode        = acdoca.rbukrs
                                                   and Doc.FiscalYear         = acdoca.gjahr
                                                   and Doc.AccountingDocument = acdoca.belnr
    inner join      t001                           on  t001.bukrs = acdoca.rbukrs
    left outer join ska1                           on  ska1.ktopl = t001.ktopl
                                                   and ska1.saknr = acdoca.racct
    left outer join skat                           on  skat.spras = $session.system_language
                                                   and skat.ktopl = t001.ktopl
                                                   and skat.saknr = acdoca.racct
    left outer join csks                           on  csks.kokrs = acdoca.kokrs
                                                   and csks.kostl = acdoca.rcntr
                                                   and csks.datbi = '99991231'
    left outer join cskt                           on  cskt.spras = $session.system_language
                                                   and cskt.kokrs = acdoca.kokrs
                                                   and cskt.kostl = acdoca.rcntr
                                                   and cskt.datbi = '99991231'
    left outer join cepct                          on  cepct.spras = $session.system_language
                                                   and cepct.kokrs = acdoca.kokrs
                                                   and cepct.prctr = acdoca.prctr
                                                   and cepct.datbi = '99991231'
    left outer join t001w                          on  t001w.werks = acdoca.werks
    left outer join lfa1                           on  lfa1.lifnr = Doc.Supplier
{
      // ===== Keys / document =====
  key acdoca.rbukrs  as CompanyCode,                       // RBUKRS
  key acdoca.gjahr   as FiscalYear,                        // GJAHR
  key acdoca.belnr   as AccountingDocument,                // BELNR
  key acdoca.docln   as LineItem,                          // DOCLN
      t001.butxt     as CompanyName,                       // T001-BUTXT
      acdoca.poper   as FiscalPeriod,                      // POPER
      acdoca.budat   as PostingDate,                       // BUDAT
      acdoca.blart   as DocumentType,                      // BLART
      acdoca.bschl   as PostingKey,                        // BSCHL
      acdoca.awref   as ReferenceDocument,                 // AWREF
      acdoca.zuonr   as Assignment,                        // ZUONR
      acdoca.sgtxt   as LineItemText,                      // SGTXT

      // ===== G/L account (OPEX classification is added in Datasphere) =====
      acdoca.racct   as GLAccount,                         // RACCT
      t001.ktopl     as ChartOfAccounts,                   // KTOPL (mapping key in Datasphere)
      skat.txt50     as GLAccountName,                     // SKAT-TXT50
      ska1.glaccount_type as AccountType,                  // SKA1-GLACCOUNT_TYPE (X/N/P/S)
      acdoca.koart   as AccountTypeOfLine,                 // KOART (S = G/L, K = vendor)
      cast( case when ska1.xbilk = 'X' then 'Balance Sheet' else 'P&L' end
            as abap.char(15) )                            as BalanceSheetOrPL,

      // ===== Amounts =====
      acdoca.drcrk   as DebitCredit,                       // DRCRK (S / H)
      acdoca.rhcur   as Currency,                          // RHCUR (company code currency, INR)
      acdoca.rwcur   as TransactionCurrency,               // RWCUR
      cast( acdoca.hsl as abap.dec(23,2) ) as AmountInCompanyCurrency,      // HSL (spec: Amount_INR)
      cast( acdoca.tsl as abap.dec(23,2) ) as AmountInTransactionCurrency,  // TSL
      Doc.DocumentNetAmount,
      cast( case when Doc.DocumentNetAmount = 0 then 'Balanced' else 'Unbalanced' end
            as abap.char(10) )                            as DocumentBalanceStatus,

      // ===== Organisation =====
      acdoca.kokrs   as ControllingArea,                   // KOKRS
      acdoca.rcntr   as CostCenter,                        // RCNTR (spec: KOSTL)
      cskt.ktext     as CostCenterName,                    // CSKT-KTEXT
      csks.abtei     as Department,                        // CSKS-ABTEI
      acdoca.prctr   as ProfitCenter,                      // PRCTR
      cepct.ktext    as ProfitCenterName,                  // CEPCT-KTEXT
      acdoca.rfarea  as FunctionalArea,                    // RFAREA
      acdoca.rbusa   as BusinessArea,                      // RBUSA
      acdoca.segment as Segment,                           // SEGMENT
      acdoca.werks   as Plant,                             // WERKS
      t001w.name1    as PlantName,                         // T001W-NAME1

      // ===== Supplier (from the document's vendor line) =====
      Doc.Supplier,
      lfa1.name1     as SupplierName,                      // NAME1
      lfa1.ktokk     as SupplierAccountGroup,              // KTOKK (basis for Supplier Type)
      //lfa1.bran1     as SupplierIndustry,                  // BRAN1 (basis for Supplier Segment)
      lfa1.land1     as SupplierCountry,                   // LAND1
      lfa1.ort01     as SupplierCity,                      // ORT01
      lfa1.regio     as SupplierRegion,                    // REGIO
      cast( case when Doc.Supplier <> '' then 'Supplier'
                 when acdoca.kunnr <> ''  then 'Customer'
                 else                          'G/L' end as abap.char(10) )  as CounterpartyType,
      cast( case when Doc.Supplier <> '' then Doc.Supplier
                 else acdoca.kunnr end as abap.char(10) )                    as CounterpartyID,

      // ===== Procurement / payment =====
      acdoca.ebeln   as PurchaseOrder,                     // EBELN
      acdoca.ebelp   as POItem,                            // EBELP
      acdoca.rebzg   as InvoiceReference,                  // REBZG
      Doc.NetDueDate,                                      // NETDT of vendor line
      case when Doc.NetDueDate is null or Doc.NetDueDate < acdoca.budat then 0
           else dats_days_between( acdoca.budat, Doc.NetDueDate ) end         as PaymentTermDays,
      Doc.ClearingDate,
      Doc.ClearingDocument,
      cast( case when Doc.ClearingDocument is null then 'Not Applicable'
                 when Doc.ClearingDocument <> ''   then 'Paid'
                 else                                   'Open' end as abap.char(15) ) as ClearingStatus,
      acdoca.gkont   as OffsetGLAccount,                   // GKONT
      acdoca.gkoar   as OffsetGLAccountType,               // GKOAR

      // ===== Time =====
      cast( concat( 'Q', cast( case when acdoca.poper <= '003' then '1'
                                    when acdoca.poper <= '006' then '2'
                                    when acdoca.poper <= '009' then '3'
                                    else '4' end as abap.char(1) ) ) as abap.char(2) ) as FiscalQuarter,
      cast( substring( acdoca.budat, 5, 2 ) as abap.numc(2) )                        as MonthNo,
      cast( concat( concat( substring( acdoca.budat, 1, 4 ), '-' ), substring( acdoca.budat, 5, 2 ) )
            as abap.char(7) )                                                       as YearMonth,
      cast( 'S/4HANA ACDOCA' as abap.char(20) )                                     as DataLineage,

      1 as LineItemCount
}
where acdoca.rldnr   = '0L'
  and Doc.ExpenseLineCount > 0       // only documents with an expense line

sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'PP: Material and production data'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@OData.publish: true
define view entity ZI_PP_MaterialProd
  as select from mara
    inner join   marc on  marc.matnr = mara.matnr

    left outer join makt on  makt.matnr = mara.matnr
                         and makt.spras = $session.system_language

    left outer join mast on  mast.matnr = marc.matnr        // BOM
                         and mast.werks = marc.werks

    left outer join crhd on  crhd.werks = marc.werks        // work centre (by plant, as before)

    left outer join mapl on  mapl.matnr = marc.matnr        // routing
                         and mapl.werks = marc.werks

    left outer join afpo on  afpo.matnr = marc.matnr        // production order
                         and afpo.dwerk = marc.werks

    left outer join vbap on  vbap.matnr = marc.matnr        // sales order
                         and vbap.werks = marc.werks

    left outer join plaf on  plaf.matnr = marc.matnr        // planned order
                         and plaf.plwrk = marc.werks
{
  key mara.matnr       as matnr,
  key marc.werks       as werks,
      mara.mtart       as mtart,
      makt.maktx       as maktx,
      min( mast.stlnr ) as stlnr,
      min( crhd.arbpl ) as arbpl,
      min( mapl.plnnr ) as plnnr,
      min( afpo.verid ) as verid,
      min( vbap.vbeln ) as vbeln,
      min( plaf.plnum ) as plnum,
      min( afpo.aufnr ) as aufnr,
      mara.laeda       as laeda,
      mara.ernam       as ernam,

      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'waerk'
      min( vbap.netwr ) as netwr,

      vbap.waerk       as waerk
}
group by
  mara.matnr,
  marc.werks,
  mara.mtart,
  makt.maktx,
  mara.laeda,
  mara.ernam,
  vbap.waerk

sqlDdl:
// Fact step 1: PO item enriched with header, master data and the
// item-grain helper views. Every join is to-one -> row count = PO items.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'PSC: Procurement Spend Base (enriched)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #D, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #MIXED }
define view entity ZI_PSC_ProcSpendBase
  as select from ZI_PSC_POItem as Item
    inner join      ZI_PSC_POHeader          as Hdr      on  Hdr.PurchaseOrder = Item.PurchaseOrder
    // ---- vendor master ----
    left outer join lfa1                                 on  lfa1.lifnr = Hdr.Supplier
    left outer join lfb1                                 on  lfb1.lifnr = Hdr.Supplier
                                                         and lfb1.bukrs = Item.CompanyCode
    left outer join lfm1                                 on  lfm1.lifnr = Hdr.Supplier
                                                         and lfm1.ekorg = Hdr.PurchasingOrganization
    // ---- company code + fiscal calendar ----
    left outer join t001                                 on  t001.bukrs = Item.CompanyCode
    left outer join I_FiscalCalendarDate     as FiscCal  on  FiscCal.FiscalYearVariant = t001.periv
                                                         and FiscCal.CalendarDate      = Hdr.PurchaseOrderDate
    // ---- contract (KONNR/KTPNR -> contract EBELN/EBELP) ----
    left outer join ekpo                     as CtrItm   on  CtrItm.ebeln = Item.Contract
                                                         and CtrItm.ebelp = Item.ContractItem
    left outer join ekko                     as CtrHdr   on  CtrHdr.ebeln = CtrItm.ebeln
    // ---- plant + state ----
    left outer join t001w                                on  t001w.werks = Item.Plant
    left outer join t005u                                on  t005u.spras = $session.system_language
                                                         and t005u.land1 = t001w.land1
                                                         and t005u.bland = t001w.regio
    left outer join t023t                                on  t023t.spras = $session.system_language
                                                         and t023t.matkl = Item.MaterialGroup
    left outer join ekkn                                 on  ekkn.ebeln = Item.PurchaseOrder
                                                         and ekkn.ebelp = Item.PurchaseOrderItem
                                                         and ekkn.zekkn = '01'                                                     
    // ---- item-grain helpers (steps 3-6) ----
    left outer join ZI_PSC_POScheduleAgg     as Sched    on  Sched.PurchaseOrder     = Item.PurchaseOrder
                                                         and Sched.PurchaseOrderItem = Item.PurchaseOrderItem
    left outer join ZI_PSC_POGoodsReceiptAgg as GR       on  GR.PurchaseOrder     = Item.PurchaseOrder
                                                         and GR.PurchaseOrderItem = Item.PurchaseOrderItem
    left outer join ZI_PSC_POInvoiceAgg      as Inv      on  Inv.PurchaseOrder     = Item.PurchaseOrder
                                                         and Inv.PurchaseOrderItem = Item.PurchaseOrderItem
    left outer join ZI_PSC_InvoiceAPStatus   as LatestAP on  LatestAP.InvoiceSortKey = Inv.LatestInvoiceSortKey
{
  key Item.PurchaseOrder,
  key Item.PurchaseOrderItem,

      // ---- Vendor ----------------------------------------------------------
      Hdr.Supplier,
      lfa1.name1                        as SupplierName,
      lfa1.land1                        as SupplierCountry,
      lfa1.ktokk                        as SupplierAccountGroup,
      lfb1.zterm                        as VendorPaymentTerms,
      lfb1.akont                        as ReconciliationAccount,
      lfm1.waers                        as SupplierOrderCurrency,

      // ---- Organisation / header -------------------------------------------
      Item.CompanyCode,
      Hdr.PurchasingOrganization,
      Hdr.PurchasingGroup,
      Hdr.PurchaseOrderType,
      Hdr.PurchasingProcessingStatus,
      Hdr.CreatedByUser,
      Hdr.CreationDate,
      Hdr.PurchaseOrderDate,
      Item.DocumentCurrency,
      t001.periv                        as FiscalYearVariant,
      FiscCal.FiscalYear,
      FiscCal.FiscalPeriod,

      // ---- Item ------------------------------------------------------------
      Item.Material,
      Item.MaterialGroup,
      t023t.wgbez                       as MaterialGroupName,           // T023T-WGBEZ
      ekkn.sakto                        as GLAccount,                   // EKKN-SAKTO
      ekkn.kostl                        as AccountAssignmentCostCenter, // EKKN-KOSTL
      Item.PurchaseOrderItemText,
      Item.PurchasingItemCategory,
      Item.AccountAssignmentCategory,
      Item.OrderQuantityUnit,
      @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'OrderQuantityUnit'
      Item.OrderQuantity,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'DocumentCurrency'
      Item.NetPriceAmount,
      Item.NetPriceQuantity,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'DocumentCurrency'
      Item.NetOrderValue,
      Item.OrderQuantityNumeric,
      Item.NetOrderValueNumeric,
      cast( case when Item.OrderQuantityNumeric <> 0
                 then division( Item.NetOrderValueNumeric, Item.OrderQuantityNumeric, 4 )
                 else cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,4) ) end as abap.dec(15,4) ) as POUnitPriceNumeric,

      // ---- Contract --------------------------------------------------------
      Item.Contract,
      Item.ContractItem,
      CtrHdr.kdatb                      as ContractValidityStartDate,
      CtrHdr.kdate                      as ContractValidityEndDate,
      case when Item.Contract = ''                          then 0
           when CtrHdr.ebeln is null                        then 0   // contract not found
           when CtrHdr.bstyp <> 'K'                         then 0   // reference is not a contract
           when CtrHdr.loekz = 'L' or CtrItm.loekz = 'L'    then 0   // contract deleted
           when Hdr.PurchaseOrderDate < CtrHdr.kdatb        then 0   // PO before validity
           when Hdr.PurchaseOrderDate > CtrHdr.kdate        then 0   // PO after validity
           else 1 end                   as IsOnValidContract,

      // ---- Schedule / delivery ---------------------------------------------
      Sched.FirstScheduleLine           as ScheduleLine,
      Sched.PlannedDeliveryDate,
      Sched.ScheduleLineCount,
      GR.LastGoodsReceiptDate,
      GR.FirstGoodsReceiptDate,
      coalesce( GR.GoodsReceiptQuantity, cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) ) as GoodsReceiptQuantity,
      coalesce( GR.GoodsReceiptAmount,   cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as GoodsReceiptAmount,
      case when GR.GoodsReceiptQuantity >= Item.OrderQuantityNumeric then 1 else 0 end as IsInFull,
      case when GR.LastGoodsReceiptDate is null                      then 0
           when GR.LastGoodsReceiptDate <= Sched.PlannedDeliveryDate then 1
           else 0 end                   as IsOnTime,
      case when GR.GoodsReceiptQuantity > 0                          then 1
           when Sched.PlannedDeliveryDate < $session.system_date     then 1
           else 0 end                   as IsOTIFEligible,

      // ---- Invoice / AP ----------------------------------------------------
      cast( substring( Inv.LatestInvoiceSortKey, 5, 10 ) as abap.char(10) ) as SupplierInvoice,
      cast( substring( Inv.LatestInvoiceSortKey, 1, 4 )  as abap.numc(4) )  as InvoiceFiscalYear,
      Inv.InvoicePostingDate,
      Inv.InvoiceDocumentCount,
      coalesce( Inv.InvoiceAmount,   cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as InvoiceAmount,
      coalesce( Inv.InvoiceQuantity, cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) ) ) as InvoiceQuantity,
      coalesce( Inv.APOpenAmount,    cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as APOpenAmount,
      coalesce( Inv.APClearedAmount, cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as APClearedAmount,
      cast( case when Inv.InvoiceQuantity <> 0
                 then division( Inv.InvoiceAmount, Inv.InvoiceQuantity, 4 )
                 else cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,4) ) end as abap.dec(15,4) ) as InvoiceUnitPriceNumeric,
      LatestAP.PaymentBaselineDate,
      LatestAP.APPaymentTerms,
      LatestAP.ClearingDate,
      coalesce( Inv.DiscountBaseAmount, cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as DiscountBaseAmount,
      coalesce( Inv.CashDiscountTaken,  cast( 0 as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) as CashDiscountTaken,
      coalesce( Inv.BlockedInvoiceLineCount, 0 )                     as BlockedInvoiceLineCount,
      Inv.PaymentBlockReason,

      // ---- Plant / state ---------------------------------------------------
      Item.Plant,
      t001w.name1                       as PlantName,
      t001w.land1                       as PlantCountry,
      t001w.regio                       as Region,
      t005u.bezei                       as RegionName
}
/*+[internal] {
"BASEINFO":
{
"FROM":
[
"I_FISCALCALENDARDATE",
"ZI_PSC_INVOICEAPSTATUS",
"ZI_PSC_POGOODSRECEIPTAGG",
"ZI_PSC_POHEADER",
"ZI_PSC_POINVOICEAGG",
"ZI_PSC_POITEM",
"ZI_PSC_POSCHEDULEAGG",
"EKKN",
"EKKO",

"LFB1",

],

ZI_PSC_SUPPLIERINVOICEITEM
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'PSC: Supplier Invoice Item (RBKP/RSEG)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #BASIC
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #B, sizeCategory: #L, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_PSC_SupplierInvoiceItem
  as select from rseg
    inner join   rbkp on  rbkp.belnr = rseg.belnr
                      and rbkp.gjahr = rseg.gjahr
{
  key rseg.belnr  as SupplierInvoice,                 // BELNR
  key rseg.gjahr  as FiscalYear,                      // GJAHR
  key rseg.buzei  as SupplierInvoiceItem,             // BUZEI
      rseg.ebeln  as PurchaseOrder,                   // EBELN
      rseg.ebelp  as PurchaseOrderItem,               // EBELP
      rbkp.bukrs  as CompanyCode,                     // BUKRS
      rbkp.lifnr  as InvoicingParty,                  // LIFNR
      rbkp.budat  as PostingDate,                     // BUDAT
      rbkp.bldat  as DocumentDate,                    // BLDAT
      rbkp.rbstat as SupplierInvoiceStatus,           // RBSTAT (5 = posted)
      rbkp.stblg  as ReverseDocument,                 // STBLG
      rbkp.waers  as DocumentCurrency,                // WAERS
      rseg.shkzg  as DebitCreditCode,                 // SHKZG (S = invoice, H = credit memo)
      rseg.tbtkz  as IsSubsequentDebitCredit,         // TBTKZ
            rbkp.zlspr  as PaymentBlockReason,              // ZLSPR (R = blocked for invoice verification)
      // Invoice line blocked for price / quantity / date / amount / manual reasons
      case when rseg.spgrp = 'X' or rseg.spgrm = 'X' or rseg.spgrt = 'X'
             or rseg.spgrg = 'X' or rseg.spgrq = 'X' or rseg.spgrs = 'X'
           then 1 else 0 end                          as IsBlockedLine,
      // Line share of the invoice net amount (gross - tax) - used to allocate discounts
      cast( case when rbkp.rmwwr <> rbkp.wmwst1
                 then division( cast( rseg.wrbtr as abap.dec(17,2) ),
                                cast( rbkp.rmwwr as abap.dec(17,2) ) - cast( rbkp.wmwst1 as abap.dec(17,2) ), 6 )
                 else cast( 0 as abap.dec(9,6) ) end as abap.dec(9,6) ) as InvoiceShare,
      cast( case rseg.shkzg when 'H' then cast( rseg.wrbtr as abap.dec(17,2) ) * -1
                            else          cast( rseg.wrbtr as abap.dec(17,2) ) end
            as abap.dec(17,2) )                                        as SignedAmount,

      // Subsequent debits/credits change value only, never quantity
      cast( case when rseg.tbtkz = 'X' then cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,3) )
                 when rseg.shkzg = 'H' then cast( rseg.menge as abap.dec(15,3) ) * -1
                 else                       cast( rseg.menge as abap.dec(15,3) ) end
            as abap.dec(15,3) )                                        as SignedQuantity,

      // Join key to the FI/AP side (year + invoice number)
      concat( rseg.gjahr, rseg.belnr )                                 as InvoiceDocumentKey,

      // Used to pick the latest non-reversed invoice per PO item
      case when rseg.shkzg = 'S' and rbkp.stblg = ''
           then concat( rseg.gjahr, rseg.belnr ) end                   as InvoiceSortKey,
      case when rseg.shkzg = 'S' and rbkp.stblg = ''
           then rbkp.budat end                                         as ValidInvoicePostingDate
}
