ZI_PURCHASEREGISTER_P1
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Purchase Register - MIRO based (P1)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZI_PurchaseRegister_P1
  with parameters
    P_CompanyCodeLow : bukrs,
    P_CompanyCodeHigh : bukrs,
    P_FiscalYearLow  : gjahr,
    P_FiscalYearHigh : gjahr,
    P_FromDate       : budat,
    P_ToDate         : budat,
    P_PlantLow       : werks_d,
    P_PlantHigh      : werks_d
  as select from rbkp                        as inv
    inner join   rseg                        as itm  on  itm.belnr = inv.belnr
                                                     and itm.gjahr = inv.gjahr
    // FI document of the invoice (same link the old report used: AWKEY = belnr + year)
    left outer join bkpf                     as fi   on  fi.bukrs = inv.bukrs
                                                     and fi.gjahr = inv.gjahr
                                                     and fi.awkey = concat( cast( inv.belnr as abap.char( 10 ) ),
                                                                            cast( inv.gjahr as abap.char( 4 ) ) )
    left outer join ZI_PurReg_LedgerAgg       as led
                                                     on  led.CompanyCode         = fi.bukrs
                                                     and led.FiscalYear          = fi.gjahr
                                                     and led.AccountingDocument  = fi.belnr
                                                     and led.SupplierInvoiceItem = itm.buzei
    left outer join ZI_PurReg_VendorLine      as vnd
                                                     on  vnd.CompanyCode        = fi.bukrs
                                                     and vnd.FiscalYear         = fi.gjahr
                                                     and vnd.AccountingDocument = fi.belnr
    left outer join t001                     as cc   on  cc.bukrs = inv.bukrs
    left outer join lfa1                     as sup  on  sup.lifnr = inv.lifnr
    left outer join t005t                    as cty  on  cty.spras = $session.system_language
                                                     and cty.land1 = sup.land1
    left outer join t005u                    as sst  on  sst.spras = $session.system_language
                                                     and sst.land1 = sup.land1
                                                     and sst.bland = sup.regio
    left outer join ekko                     as po   on  po.ebeln  = itm.ebeln
    left outer join ekpo                     as poi  on  poi.ebeln = itm.ebeln
                                                     and poi.ebelp = itm.ebelp
    left outer join t001w                    as plt  on  plt.werks = poi.werks
    left outer join t005u                    as pos  on  pos.spras = $session.system_language
                                                     and pos.land1 = plt.land1
                                                     and pos.bland = plt.regio
    left outer join makt                     as mat  on  mat.matnr = itm.matnr
                                                     and mat.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join marc                     as mrc  on  mrc.matnr = itm.matnr
                                                     and mrc.werks = itm.werks
    left outer join mara                     as mra  on  mra.matnr = itm.matnr
    left outer join mkpf                     as grn  on  grn.mblnr = itm.lfbnr
                                                     and grn.mjahr = itm.lfgja
    left outer join t025t                    as vcl  on  vcl.spras = $session.system_language
                                                     and vcl.bklas = itm.bklas
    left outer join t030                     as gl   on  gl.ktopl = cc.ktopl
                                                     and gl.ktosl = 'BSX'
                                                     and gl.bwmod = ''
                                                     and gl.bklas = itm.bklas
    left outer join ZI_PurReg_TaxAmt          as tax
                                                     on  tax.CompanyCode        = fi.bukrs
                                                     and tax.AccountingDocument = fi.belnr
                                                     and tax.FiscalYear         = fi.gjahr
    left outer join ZI_PurReg_VatLine         as vtx  on  vtx.CompanyCode        = fi.bukrs
                                                     and vtx.AccountingDocument = fi.belnr
                                                     and vtx.FiscalYear         = fi.gjahr
    left outer join t005                     as ctp  on  ctp.land1 = cc.land1
    left outer join t007s                    as txt  on  txt.spras = $session.system_language
                                                     and txt.mwskz = itm.mwskz
                                                     and txt.kalsm = ctp.kalsm
{
  // keys = invoice item; AccountingDocument can repeat when an invoice has several FI docs
  key inv.bukrs                                   as CompanyCode,
  key inv.belnr                                   as MiroInvoiceNo,
  key inv.gjahr                                   as FiscalYear,
  key itm.buzei                                   as MiroInvoiceItem,

      // ---- header ----
      fi.belnr                                    as AccountingDocument,
      fi.blart                                    as DocumentType,
      fi.xblnr_alt                                as OdnNo,
      inv.bldat                                   as DocumentDate,
      inv.budat                                   as PostingDate,
      inv.xblnr                                   as ReferenceNo,
      inv.waers                                   as Currency,
      inv.kursf                                   as ExchangeRate,
      inv.xrech                                   as IsInvoice,
      led.BusinessArea                            as BusinessArea,
      itm.werks                                   as Plant,

      // ---- vendor ----
      inv.lifnr                                   as Vendor,
      sup.name1                                   as VendorName,
      sup.ort01                                   as City,
      sst.bezei                                   as State,
      cty.landx                                   as Country,
      case when sup.stcd1 <> '' then sup.stcd1
           when sup.stcd2 <> '' then sup.stcd2
           else sup.stcd3 end                     as VatNumber,
      sup.stenr                                   as GstNumber,
      case when sup.stcd1 = 'SEZ' then 'SEZ'
           else 'R' end                           as InvoiceType,
      vnd.ReconciliationGL                        as VendorReconGL,

      // ---- material / PO / GRN ----
      itm.matnr                                   as Material,
      case when itm.matnr <> '' then mat.maktx
           else poi.txz01 end                     as MaterialDescription,
      mra.mtart                                   as MaterialType,
      mrc.steuc                                   as HsnCode,
      itm.ebeln                                   as PurchaseOrder,
      po.bedat                                    as PurchaseOrderDate,
      itm.lfbnr                                   as GrnNumber,
      grn.budat                                   as GrnDate,
      itm.bklas                                   as ValuationClass,
      vcl.bkbez                                   as ValuationClassDesc,
      itm.bstme                                   as UnitOfMeasure,
      case inv.xrech when 'X' then cast( itm.menge as abap.dec( 13, 3 ) )
           else cast( itm.menge as abap.dec( 13, 3 ) ) * -1 end
                                                  as Quantity,

      // ---- tax ----
      itm.mwskz                                   as TaxCode,
      txt.text1                                   as TaxCodeDescription,
      concat( concat( plt.regio, '-' ), pos.bezei ) as PlaceOfSupply,
      coalesce( tax.ReverseChargeFlag, '' )       as ReverseChargeFlag,
      tax.CgstPercent                             as CgstPercent,
      tax.SgstPercent                             as SgstPercent,
      tax.IgstPercent                             as IgstPercent,
      tax.CgstAmount                              as CgstAmount,
      tax.SgstAmount                              as SgstAmount,
      tax.IgstAmount                              as IgstAmount,

      // Generic VAT fields - use these when CGST/SGST/IGST above are blank (non-GST company)
      coalesce( tax.VatRateGeneric, 0 )           as VatRate,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      coalesce( cast( vtx.VatAmount as abap.dec( 23, 2 ) ), tax.VatAmountGeneric )  as VatAmount,
      vtx.VatCode                                 as VatCode,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      tax.VatTaxBaseAmount                        as VatTaxBaseAmount,

      // ---- amounts ----
      coalesce( led.GLCode, gl.konts )             as GLCode,
      led.DocCurrency                             as DocCurrency,
      led.LocalCurrency                           as LocalCurrency,
      led.HardCurrency                            as HardCurrency,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'DocCurrency'
      coalesce( led.AmountDocCurr, itm.wrbtr )     as AmountDocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'DocCurrency'
      led.OtherChargesDocCurr                     as OtherChargesDocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      coalesce( led.AmountLocCurr, itm.wrbtr )     as AmountLocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      led.OtherChargesLocCurr                     as OtherChargesLocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      coalesce( led.TaxableAmountLocCurr, itm.wrbtr ) as TaxableAmount,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      vnd.VendorAmountLocCurr                     as VendorAmountLocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'HardCurrency'
      led.AmountHardCurr                          as AmountHardCurr,
      case when itm.menge <> 0
           then division( cast( itm.wrbtr as abap.dec( 23, 2 ) ),
                          cast( itm.menge as abap.dec( 13, 3 ) ), 2 )
           else 0 end                             as UnitRate
}
where
      inv.rbstat = '5'
  and inv.bukrs  between $parameters.P_CompanyCodeLow and $parameters.P_CompanyCodeHigh
  and inv.gjahr  between $parameters.P_FiscalYearLow  and $parameters.P_FiscalYearHigh
  and inv.budat  between $parameters.P_FromDate       and $parameters.P_ToDate
  and ( itm.werks between $parameters.P_PlantLow and $parameters.P_PlantHigh
        or ( itm.werks = '' and poi.werks between $parameters.P_PlantLow and $parameters.P_PlantHigh ) )
  and itm.kschl <> 'JSWS'

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZIPURCHREGDOC'
@AbapCatalog.compiler.compareFilter: true
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Purchase Register GL - Document Header'
define view ZI_PurchRegDoc
  as select distinct from bkpf
   left outer join   acdoca on  acdoca.rbukrs = bkpf.bukrs
                        and acdoca.belnr  = bkpf.belnr
                        and acdoca.ryear  = bkpf.gjahr
    left outer join t001 as _CompanyCode on _CompanyCode.bukrs = bkpf.bukrs

    association [0..*] to ZI_PurchRegDetail   as _MainLine  on  _MainLine.Bukrs = $projection.Bukrs
                                                             and _MainLine.Belnr = $projection.Belnr
                                                             and _MainLine.Gjahr = $projection.Gjahr

    association [0..1] to ZI_PurchRegGrossSum as _GrossSum   on  _GrossSum.Bukrs = $projection.Bukrs
                                                              and _GrossSum.Belnr = $projection.Belnr
                                                              and _GrossSum.Gjahr = $projection.Gjahr
{
  key bkpf.bukrs                                       as Bukrs,
  key bkpf.belnr                                        as Belnr,
  key bkpf.gjahr                                        as Gjahr,
      bkpf.blart                                        as Blart,
      bkpf.bldat                                        as Bldat,
      bkpf.budat                                        as Budat,
      bkpf.xblnr                                        as Xblnr,
      bkpf.waers                                        as Waers,
      bkpf.kursf                                        as Kursf,
      bkpf.bktxt                                        as Bktxt,
      bkpf.xreversal                                    as Xreversal,
      acdoca.lifnr                                      as AcdocaLifnr,
      _CompanyCode.land1                                as CompanyLand1,

      // Mirrors ABAP LV_SHKZG derivation
      case
        when bkpf.blart = 'KR' or bkpf.blart = 'KA'
          then case when bkpf.xreversal = '2' then 'H' else 'S' end
        when bkpf.blart = 'KG'
          then case when bkpf.xreversal = '2' then 'S' else 'H' end
        else ''
      end                                                as DerivedShkzg,

      // Mirrors the final *-1 reversal loop at the end of PROCESS_DATA_ALL
      case
        when bkpf.blart = 'KG' and bkpf.xreversal = '1'                       then -1
        when bkpf.xreversal = '2' and ( bkpf.blart = 'KR' or bkpf.blart = 'KA' ) then -1
        when bkpf.blart = 'KG'                                                then -1
        else 1
      end                                                as SignMultiplier,

      // Associations used further down the stack
      _MainLine,
      _GrossSum
}
where bkpf.blart = 'KR' or bkpf.blart = 'KA' or bkpf.blart = 'KG'

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Purchase Register - Invoice Base Data'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZI_PurReg_InvoiceBase
  as select from rbkp as _Header
    inner join rseg as _Item
      on  _Header.belnr = _Item.belnr
      and _Header.gjahr = _Item.gjahr
      
{
  key _Header.belnr                        as InvoiceDocNumber,
  key _Header.gjahr                        as FiscalYear,
  key _Item.buzei                          as InvoiceLineItem,

      _Header.blart                        as DocumentType,
      _Header.bldat                        as DocumentDate,
      _Header.budat                        as PostingDate,
      _Header.xblnr                        as VendorInvoiceNo,
      _Header.bukrs                        as CompanyCode,
      _Header.lifnr                        as Vendor,
//      _Header.waers                        as Currency,
//      _Header.kursf                        as ExchangeRate,
//      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode:'WAERS'
//@Semantics.currencyCode: true
      _Header.waers as WAERS,
     _Header.kursf as ExchangeRate,
@Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'WAERS'
      _Header.rmwwr as GrossInvoiceAmount,
//      _Header.rmwwr                        as GrossInvoiceAmount,
      _Header.xrech                        as InvoiceIndicator,
      _Header.bktxt                        as DocumentHeaderText,
      _Header.sgtxt                        as HeaderItemText,
      _Header.regio                        as SupplierRegion,

      _Item.ebeln                          as PurchaseOrder,
      _Item.ebelp                          as PurchaseOrderItem,
      _Item.matnr                          as Material,
      _Item.werks                          as Plant,
      
       @Semantics.amount .currencyCode: 'Waers'
      _Item.wrbtr                          as AmountInDocCurrency,
      _Item.shkzg                          as DebitCreditIndicator,
      _Item.mwskz                          as TaxCode,
      
      _Item.meins as MEINS,
      @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'Meins'
      _Item.menge                          as Quantity,
      _Item.bstme                          as OrderUnit,
      _Item.meins                          as BaseUnitOfMeasure,
      _Item.pstyp                          as ItemCategory,
      _Item.knttp                          as AccountAssignmentCat,
      _Item.bklas                          as ValuationClass,
      _Item.xekbz                          as FinalInvoiceIndicator,
      _Item.kschl                          as ConditionType,
      
//      _Item.salk3                          as ConditionValue,
      cast( _Item.salk3 as abap.dec(15,2) ) as ConditionValue,
      _Item.lfbnr                          as ReferenceDocNumber,
      _Item.lfpos                          as ReferenceDocItem,
      _Item.packno                         as PackageNumber,
      _Item.introw                         as InternalRow,
      _Item.sgtxt                          as ItemText,

      /* Derived: awkey for joining to bkpf                              */
      /* Replicates ABAP: CONCATENATE l_belnr l_gjahr INTO g_awkey-awkey */
      cast(
        concat( _Header.belnr,
                cast( _Header.gjahr as abap.char( 4 ) )
              ) as abap.char( 20 )
      )                                    as AwKey,

      /* Unit rate = wrbtr / menge     */
      case when _Item.menge <> 0
           then cast( _Item.wrbtr as abap.dec( 15, 2 ) )
                / cast( _Item.menge as abap.dec( 15, 2 ) )
           else cast( 0 as abap.dec( 15, 2 ) )
      end                                 as UnitRate,

                
             
      case _Header.bukrs
        when '5001' then cast( 'ZTAXEG' as abap.char( 6 ) )
        when '5002' then cast( 'TAXD'   as abap.char( 6 ) )
        when '5011' then cast( 'TAXD'   as abap.char( 6 ) )
        when '5003' then cast( 'TAXUS'  as abap.char( 6 ) )
        when '5004' then cast( 'TAXNL'  as abap.char( 6 ) )
        when '5012' then cast( 'TAXTR'  as abap.char( 6 ) )
        else             cast( ''       as abap.char( 6 ) )
      end                                 as TaxProcedure
}

name: ZI_PURREG_LEDGERAGG
sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'PurReg P1 - Ledger lines per MIRO item'
define view entity ZI_PurReg_LedgerAgg
  as select from acdoca
{
  key rbukrs                                       as CompanyCode,
  key gjahr                                        as FiscalYear,
  key belnr                                        as AccountingDocument,
  key awitem                                       as SupplierInvoiceItem,

      rwcur                                        as DocCurrency,
      rhcur                                        as LocalCurrency,
      rocur                                        as HardCurrency,
      max( rbusa )                                 as BusinessArea,

      max( case when ( ktosl = 'WRX' or ktosl = 'BSX' or ktosl = 'KBS' or ktosl = 'FR1' or ktosl = 'ANL' )
               then racct end )                    as GLCode,

      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'DocCurrency'
      sum( case when ( ktosl = 'WRX' or ktosl = 'BSX' or ktosl = 'KBS' or ktosl = 'FR1' or ktosl = 'ANL' )
               then wsl end )                      as AmountDocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      sum( case when ( ktosl = 'WRX' or ktosl = 'BSX' or ktosl = 'KBS' or ktosl = 'FR1' or ktosl = 'ANL' )
               then hsl end )                      as AmountLocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'DocCurrency'
      sum( case when ktosl <> 'WRX' and ktosl <> 'BSX' and ktosl <> 'KBS' and ktosl <> 'FR1' and ktosl <> 'ANL'
               then wsl end )                      as OtherChargesDocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      sum( case when ktosl <> 'WRX' and ktosl <> 'BSX' and ktosl <> 'KBS' and ktosl <> 'FR1' and ktosl <> 'ANL'
               then hsl end )                      as OtherChargesLocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'LocalCurrency'
      sum( hsl )                                   as TaxableAmountLocCurr,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'HardCurrency'
      sum( osl )                                   as AmountHardCurr
}
where
      rldnr  = 'C1'
  and koart <> 'K'
group by
  rbukrs, gjahr, belnr, awitem, rwcur, rhcur, rocur

sqlDdl:
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'PurReg P1 - Tax amounts from BSET'
define view entity ZI_PurReg_TaxAmt
  as select from bset
{
  key bukrs                                                              as CompanyCode,
  key belnr                                                              as AccountingDocument,
  key gjahr                                                              as FiscalYear,

  division( max( case when ( kschl = 'JOCG' or kschl = 'CGST' ) then cast( kbetr as abap.dec( 11, 2 ) ) end ), 10, 2 ) as CgstPercent,
  cast( max( case when ( kschl = 'JOCG' or kschl = 'CGST' ) then fwste end ) as abap.dec( 23, 2 ) )                     as CgstAmount,
  division( max( case when ( kschl = 'JOSG' or kschl = 'SGST' ) then cast( kbetr as abap.dec( 11, 2 ) ) end ), 10, 2 ) as SgstPercent,
  cast( max( case when ( kschl = 'JOSG' or kschl = 'SGST' ) then fwste end ) as abap.dec( 23, 2 ) )                     as SgstAmount,
  division( max( case when ( kschl = 'JOIG' or kschl = 'IGST' ) then cast( kbetr as abap.dec( 11, 2 ) ) end ), 10, 2 ) as IgstPercent,
  cast( max( case when ( kschl = 'JOIG' or kschl = 'IGST' ) then fwste end ) as abap.dec( 23, 2 ) )                     as IgstAmount,
  max( case when ( kschl = 'JICR' or kschl = 'JISR' or kschl = 'JIUR'
                 or kschl = 'JIIR' or kschl = 'JCIR' )
           then 'X' end )                                                  as ReverseChargeFlag,

  // Generic VAT rate/amount - for companies NOT on GST (no CGST/SGST/IGST posted, e.g. 1100).
  // Same source the original report used: any BSET line with kbetr <> 0.
  division( max( cast( kbetr as abap.dec( 11, 2 ) ) ), 10, 2 )             as VatRateGeneric,
  cast( max( fwste ) as abap.dec( 23, 2 ) )                                as VatAmountGeneric,
  cast( max( fwbas ) as abap.dec( 23, 2 ) )                                as VatTaxBaseAmount
}
where
      kbetr <> 0
group by
  bukrs, belnr, gjahr

@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZI_PurReg_VendorInfo
  as select from lfa1 as _Vendor
    left outer join t005t as _Country
      on  _Country.land1 = _Vendor.land1
      and _Country.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join t005u as _State
      on  _State.land1 = _Vendor.land1
      and _State.bland = _Vendor.regio
      and _State.spras = $session.system_language
    left outer join j_1imovend as _PAN
      on  _PAN.lifnr = _Vendor.lifnr
{
  key _Vendor.lifnr          as Vendor,

      _Vendor.land1          as CountryKey,
      _Vendor.name1          as VendorName,
      _Vendor.name2          as VendorName2,
      _Vendor.ort01          as City,
      _Vendor.regio          as RegionCode,
      _Vendor.stras          as Street,
      _Vendor.stcd1          as TaxNumber1,
      _Vendor.stcd2          as TaxNumber2,
      _Vendor.stcd3          as TaxNumber3,
      _Vendor.stenr          as GSTNumber,
      _Vendor.j_1isern       as ServiceTaxRegNo,
      _Vendor.stceg          as VATRegistrationNo,

      _Country.landx         as CountryName,
      _State.bezei           as StateName,
      _PAN.j_1ipanno         as PANNumber,

      /* Invoice type: SEZ or Regular                                     */
      case when _Vendor.stcd1 = 'SEZ'
           then cast( 'SEZ' as abap.char( 3 ) )
           else cast( 'R'   as abap.char( 3 ) )
      end                    as InvoiceType,

      /* VAT Number with fallback: stcd1 → stcd2 → stcd3                 */
      case when _Vendor.stcd1 <> ''
           then _Vendor.stcd1
           when _Vendor.stcd2 <> ''
           then _Vendor.stcd2
           else _Vendor.stcd3
      end                    as VATNumber
}

// ZI_FI_JOURNAL_LINE (spec) - grain: journal entry line (ACDOCA, ledger 0L) of
// material documents that belong to an inspection lot. Quality-cost classification
// (which G/L accounts count as scrap / write-off) is applied in Datasphere.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'QMM: Quality-Related Journal Entry Line'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_QMM_QualityJournalLine
  as select from acdoca
    inner join      ZI_QMM_LotDocumentLink as Doc on  Doc.MaterialDocument        = acdoca.awref
                                                  and Doc.MaterialDocumentYearKey = acdoca.aworg
    left outer join t001                          on  t001.bukrs = acdoca.rbukrs
    left outer join skat                          on  skat.spras = $session.system_language
                                                  and skat.ktopl = t001.ktopl
                                                  and skat.saknr = acdoca.racct
{
  key acdoca.rldnr  as Ledger,                          // RLDNR
  key acdoca.rbukrs as CompanyCode,                     // RBUKRS
  key acdoca.gjahr  as FiscalYear,                      // GJAHR
  key acdoca.belnr  as AccountingDocument,              // BELNR
  key acdoca.docln  as LineItem,                        // DOCLN
      Doc.InspectionLot,
      Doc.InspectionLotCount,
      acdoca.awref  as MaterialDocument,                // AWREF
      Doc.MaterialDocumentYear,
      acdoca.budat  as PostingDate,                     // BUDAT
      acdoca.poper  as FiscalPeriod,                    // POPER
      acdoca.racct  as GLAccount,                       // RACCT
      t001.ktopl    as ChartOfAccounts,                 // mapping key for quality-cost class
      skat.txt50    as GLAccountName,
      acdoca.drcrk  as DebitCredit,                     // DRCRK
      acdoca.rcntr  as CostCenter,                      // RCNTR
      acdoca.prctr  as ProfitCenter,                    // PRCTR
      acdoca.aufnr  as OrderNumber,                     // AUFNR
      acdoca.matnr  as Material,                        // MATNR
      acdoca.werks  as Plant,                           // WERKS
      acdoca.rhcur  as Currency,                        // RHCUR
      cast( acdoca.hsl as abap.dec(23,2) ) as Amount    // HSL (signed)

sqlDdl:
// ZI_MM_MATERIAL_MOVEMENT (spec) - grain: material document item linked to an
// inspection lot. Only QM-related movements, via the QAMB link (no material/date guessing).
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'QMM: Quality-Related Material Movement'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_QMM_QualityMovement
  as select from matdoc
    inner join      ZI_QMM_LotMovementLink as Lnk on  Lnk.MaterialDocument     = matdoc.mblnr
                                                  and Lnk.MaterialDocumentYear = matdoc.mjahr
                                                  and Lnk.MaterialDocumentItem = matdoc.zeile
    left outer join makt                          on  makt.matnr = matdoc.matnr
                                                  and makt.spras = $session.system_language
{
  key matdoc.mblnr  as MaterialDocument,                // MBLNR
  key matdoc.mjahr  as MaterialDocumentYear,            // MJAHR
  key matdoc.zeile  as MaterialDocumentItem,            // ZEILE
  key Lnk.InspectionLot,                                // QAMB-PRUEFLOS
      Lnk.LinkType,
      matdoc.bwart  as GoodsMovementType,               // BWART
      cast( case
              when matdoc.bwart = '101' or matdoc.bwart = '103' or matdoc.bwart = '105' then 'Goods Receipt'
              when matdoc.bwart = '102' or matdoc.bwart = '104' or matdoc.bwart = '106' then 'GR Reversal'
              when matdoc.bwart = '321'                                                 then 'Release from QI'
              when matdoc.bwart = '322'                                                 then 'Release Reversal'
              when matdoc.bwart = '349' or matdoc.bwart = '350'                         then 'Transfer to Blocked'
              when matdoc.bwart = '551' or matdoc.bwart = '553' or matdoc.bwart = '555' then 'Scrap'
              when matdoc.bwart = '552' or matdoc.bwart = '554' or matdoc.bwart = '556' then 'Scrap Reversal'
              when matdoc.bwart = '122' or matdoc.bwart = '124' or matdoc.bwart = '161' then 'Return to Vendor'
              when matdoc.bwart = '331' or matdoc.bwart = '333'                         then 'Sample'
              else                                                                           'Other'
            end as abap.char(25) )                       as MovementCategory,
      matdoc.budat  as PostingDate,                     // BUDAT
      matdoc.matnr  as Material,                        // MATNR
      makt.maktx    as MaterialName,
      matdoc.werks  as Plant,                           // WERKS
      matdoc.lgort  as StorageLocation,                 // LGORT
      matdoc.charg  as Batch,                           // CHARG
      matdoc.insmk  as StockType,                       // INSMK (stock type of the posting)
      matdoc.ebeln  as PurchaseOrder,                   // EBELN
      matdoc.ebelp  as PurchaseOrderItem,               // EBELP
      matdoc.lifnr  as Supplier,                        // LIFNR
      matdoc.aufnr  as ProductionOrder,                 // AUFNR
      matdoc.shkzg  as DebitCreditCode,                 // SHKZG
      matdoc.meins  as BaseUnit,                        // MEINS
      matdoc.waers  as Currency,                        // WAERS
      cast( matdoc.menge as abap.dec(15,3) ) as Quantity,      // MENGE (unsigned; sign via MovementCategory)
      cast( matdoc.dmbtr as abap.dec(17,2) ) as Amount         // DMBTR (value in company code currency)
}
where matdoc.record_type = 'MDOC'
  and matdoc.xauto       = ''         // skip the automatic counter line of transfer postings

name: ZI_QMM_STOCKSNAPSHOT
sqlDdl:
// ZI_MM_STOCK_KEYDATE (spec) - grain: material + plant + storage location, current
// stock (MARD). Datasphere loads it daily -> each load is a key-date snapshot.
// Value = quantity x valuation price / price unit (standard or moving average per MBEW).
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'QMM: Stock Snapshot with Valuation'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #B, sizeCategory: #L, dataClass: #MIXED }
define view entity ZI_QMM_StockSnapshot
  as select from nsdm_e_mard as mard
    left outer join mbew  on  mbew.matnr = mard.matnr
                          and mbew.bwkey = mard.werks
                          and mbew.bwtar = ''
    left outer join t001w on  t001w.werks = mard.werks
    left outer join t001k on  t001k.bwkey = t001w.bwkey
    left outer join t001  on  t001.bukrs  = t001k.bukrs
    left outer join makt  on  makt.matnr  = mard.matnr
                          and makt.spras  = $session.system_language
{
  key mard.matnr  as Material,                          // MATNR
  key mard.werks  as Plant,                             // WERKS
  key mard.lgort  as StorageLocation,                   // LGORT
      makt.maktx  as MaterialName,
      t001w.name1 as PlantName,
      $session.system_date as SnapshotDate,
      mbew.vprsv  as PriceControl,                      // VPRSV (S / V)
      t001.waers  as Currency,
      cast( mard.labst as abap.dec(15,3) ) as UnrestrictedQuantity,   // LABST
      cast( mard.insme as abap.dec(15,3) ) as QualityInspectionQuantity, // INSME
      cast( mard.speme as abap.dec(15,3) ) as BlockedQuantity,        // SPEME
      cast( mard.retme as abap.dec(15,3) ) as ReturnsBlockedQuantity, // RETME
      // Price per base unit (standard price for S, moving average for V)
      cast( case when mbew.peinh > 0
                 then division( cast( case mbew.vprsv when 'S' then mbew.stprs else mbew.verpr end
                                      as abap.dec(17,2) ),
                                cast( mbew.peinh as abap.dec(5,0) ), 6 )
                 else cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,6) ) end as abap.dec(15,6) ) as UnitPrice,
      // Estimated exposure values (NOT actual losses)
      cast( cast( mard.insme as abap.dec(15,3) )
          * cast( case when mbew.peinh > 0
                       then division( cast( case mbew.vprsv when 'S' then mbew.stprs else mbew.verpr end
                                            as abap.dec(17,2) ),
                                      cast( mbew.peinh as abap.dec(5,0) ), 6 )
                       else cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,6) ) end as abap.dec(15,6) )
            as abap.dec(17,2) )                          as EstQIStockValue,
      cast( cast( mard.speme as abap.dec(15,3) )
          * cast( case when mbew.peinh > 0
                       then division( cast( case mbew.vprsv when 'S' then mbew.stprs else mbew.verpr end
                                            as abap.dec(17,2) ),
                                      cast( mbew.peinh as abap.dec(5,0) ), 6 )
                       else cast( 0 as abap.dec(15,6) ) end as abap.dec(15,6) )
            as abap.dec(17,2) )                          as EstBlockedStockValue
}
where mard.insme <> 0
   or mard.speme <> 0
   or mard.labst <> 0
/*+[internal] {

name: ZI_RVA_BILLINGITEM
sqlDdl:
// Revenue Analytics - step 1: billing item (VBRK/VBRP), one row per billing item.
// Adds the sign (+1 / -1) and converts amounts to company code currency.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'RVA: Billing Item (VBRK/VBRP)'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #BASIC
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #B, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_RVA_BillingItem
  as select from vbrp
    inner join   vbrk on vbrk.vbeln = vbrp.vbeln
    inner join   t001 on t001.bukrs = vbrk.bukrs
{
  key vbrp.vbeln  as BillingDocument,                   // VBELN
  key vbrp.posnr  as BillingDocumentItem,               // POSNR
      vbrk.fkart  as BillingDocumentType,               // FKART
      vbrk.vbtyp  as SDDocumentCategory,                // VBTYP (M/N/O/P/S)
      vbrk.fkdat  as BillingDate,                       // FKDAT
      vbrk.gjahr  as FiscalYear,                        // GJAHR
      vbrk.poper  as FiscalPeriod,                      // POPER
      vbrk.bukrs  as CompanyCode,                       // BUKRS
      vbrk.vkorg  as SalesOrganization,                 // VKORG
      vbrk.vtweg  as DistributionChannel,               // VTWEG
      vbrk.spart  as Division,                          // SPART
      vbrk.kunag  as SoldToParty,                       // KUNAG
      vbrk.kunrg  as PayerParty,                        // KUNRG
      vbrk.land1  as DestinationCountry,                // LAND1
      vbrk.rfbsk  as AccountingTransferStatus,          // RFBSK (C = posted to FI)
      vbrk.fksto  as IsCancelled,                       // FKSTO
      vbrp.vkbur  as SalesOffice,                       // VKBUR
      vbrp.vkgrp  as SalesGroup,                        // VKGRP
      vbrp.werks  as Plant,
      vbrp.prctr  as ProfitCenter,                      // PRCTR
      vbrp.kostl  as CostCenter,                        // KOSTL
      vbrp.prsdt  as PricingDate,                       // PRSDT                             // WERKS
      vbrp.matnr  as Material,                          // MATNR
      vbrp.arktx  as BillingItemText,                   // ARKTX
      vbrp.matkl  as MaterialGroup,                     // MATKL
      vbrp.prodh  as ProductHierarchy,                  // PRODH
      vbrp.pstyv  as ItemCategory,                      // PSTYV
      vbrp.aubel  as SalesOrder,                        // AUBEL
      vbrp.aupos  as SalesOrderItem,                    // AUPOS
      vbrp.vgbel  as ReferenceDelivery,                 // VGBEL
      vbrp.vrkme  as SalesUnit,                         // VRKME

      // Credit memos and invoice cancellations reduce revenue
      case when vbrk.vbtyp = 'N' or vbrk.vbtyp = 'O' then -1 else 1 end as SignFactor,

      cast( vbrp.fkimg as abap.dec(15,3) ) as BilledQuantity,          // FKIMG

      // ---- Document currency ----
      vbrk.waerk  as TransactionCurrency,               // WAERK
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'TransactionCurrency'
      vbrp.netwr  as NetAmount,                         // NETWR
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'TransactionCurrency'
      vbrp.wavwr  as CostAmount,                        // WAVWR (cost of goods sold)
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'TransactionCurrency'
      vbrp.kzwi1  as GrossAmount,                       // KZWI1 (subtotal 1 = gross, check pricing procedure)
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'TransactionCurrency'
      vbrp.mwsbp  as TaxAmount,                         // MWSBP

      // ---- Company code currency (converted at billing date, rate type M) ----
      t001.waers  as CompanyCodeCurrency,               // T001-WAERS
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'CompanyCodeCurrency'
      currency_conversion( amount             => vbrp.netwr,
                           source_currency    => vbrk.waerk,
                           target_currency    => t001.waers,
                           exchange_rate_date => vbrk.fkdat,
                           exchange_rate_type => 'M',
                           error_handling     => 'SET_TO_NULL' ) as NetAmountInCCCrcy,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'CompanyCodeCurrency'
      currency_conversion( amount             => vbrp.wavwr,
                           source_currency    => vbrk.waerk,
                           target_currency    => t001.waers,
                           exchange_rate_date => vbrk.fkdat,
                           exchange_rate_type => 'M',
                           error_handling     => 'SET_TO_NULL' ) as CostAmountInCCCrcy,
      @Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'CompanyCodeCurrency'
      currency_conversion( amount             => vbrp.kzwi1,
                           source_currency    => vbrk.waerk,
                           target_currency    => t001.waers,
                           exchange_rate_date => vbrk.fkdat,
                           exchange_rate_type => 'M',
                           error_handling     => 'SET_TO_NULL' ) as GrossAmountInCCCrcy
}
where ( vbrk.vbtyp = 'M'      // invoice
     or vbrk.vbtyp = 'N'      // invoice cancellation
     or vbrk.vbtyp = 'O'      // credit memo
     or vbrk.vbtyp = 'P'      // debit memo
     or vbrk.vbtyp = 'S' )    // credit memo cancellation

name: ZI_RVA_REVENUEFACT
sqlDdl:
// Revenue Analytics & Profitability fact - grain: billing document item.
// Amounts are signed (credit memos / cancellations negative), so they can be summed.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'RVA: Revenue & Profitability Fact'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
@Analytics.dataCategory: #FACT
@Analytics.dataExtraction.enabled: true
@ObjectModel.usageType: { serviceQuality: #C, sizeCategory: #XL, dataClass: #TRANSACTIONAL }
define view entity ZI_RVA_RevenueFact
  as select from ZI_RVA_BillingItem as B
    left outer join kna1  on  kna1.kunnr  = B.SoldToParty
    left outer join knvv  on  knvv.kunnr  = B.SoldToParty
                          and knvv.vkorg  = B.SalesOrganization
                          and knvv.vtweg  = B.DistributionChannel
                          and knvv.spart  = B.Division
    left outer join t151t on  t151t.spras = $session.system_language
                          and t151t.kdgrp = knvv.kdgrp
    left outer join makt  on  makt.spras  = $session.system_language
                          and makt.matnr  = B.Material
    left outer join t179t on  t179t.spras = $session.system_language
                          and t179t.prodh = B.ProductHierarchy
    left outer join tvkot on  tvkot.spras = $session.system_language
                          and tvkot.vkorg = B.SalesOrganization
    left outer join t188t on  t188t.spras = $session.system_language
                          and t188t.konda = knvv.konda
    left outer join mara  on  mara.matnr  = B.Material
    left outer join mbew  on  mbew.matnr  = B.Material
                          and mbew.bwkey  = B.Plant
                          and mbew.bwtar  = ''  
    left outer join t001w on  t001w.werks = B.Plant
    left outer join tka02 on  tka02.bukrs = B.CompanyCode
                          and tka02.gsber = ''
    left outer join csks  on  csks.kokrs  = tka02.kokrs
                          and csks.kostl  = B.CostCenter
                          and csks.datab <= B.BillingDate
                          and csks.datbi >= B.BillingDate
    left outer join cskt  on  cskt.kokrs  = csks.kokrs
                          and cskt.kostl  = csks.kostl
                          and cskt.datbi  = csks.datbi
                          and cskt.spras  = $session.system_language
    left outer join cepc  on  cepc.kokrs  = tka02.kokrs
                          and cepc.prctr  = B.ProfitCenter
                          and cepc.datab <= B.BillingDate
                          and cepc.datbi >= B.BillingDate
    left outer join cepct on  cepct.kokrs = cepc.kokrs
                          and cepct.prctr = cepc.prctr
                          and cepct.datbi = cepc.datbi
                          and cepct.spras = $session.system_language                                           
{
  key B.BillingDocument,
  key B.BillingDocumentItem,
      B.BillingDocumentType,
      B.SDDocumentCategory,
      cast( case B.SDDocumentCategory when 'M' then 'Invoice'
                                      when 'N' then 'Invoice Cancellation'
                                      when 'O' then 'Credit Memo'
                                      when 'P' then 'Debit Memo'
                                      when 'S' then 'Credit Memo Cancellation'
                                      else          'Other' end as abap.char(25) ) as BillingCategory,
      B.BillingDate,
      B.FiscalYear,
      B.FiscalPeriod,
      B.AccountingTransferStatus,
      B.IsCancelled,

      // ---- Organisation ----
      B.CompanyCode,
      B.SalesOrganization,
      tvkot.vtext   as SalesOrganizationName,           // TVKOT-VTEXT
      B.DistributionChannel,
      B.Division,
      B.SalesOffice,
      B.SalesGroup,
      B.Plant,
      B.ProfitCenter,
      B.CostCenter,
      B.PricingDate,

      // ---- Customer ----
      B.SoldToParty,
      kna1.name1    as SoldToPartyName,                 // KNA1-NAME1
      kna1.land1    as CustomerCountry,                 // KNA1-LAND1
      kna1.regio    as CustomerRegion,                  // KNA1-REGIO
      kna1.ort01    as CustomerCity,                    // KNA1-ORT01
      knvv.kdgrp    as CustomerGroup,                   // KNVV-KDGRP
      t151t.ktext   as CustomerGroupName,               // T151T-KTEXT
      knvv.konda    as CustomerPriceGroup,              // KNVV-KONDA
      t188t.vtext   as CustomerPriceGroupName,          // T188T-VTEXT
      B.PayerParty,
      B.DestinationCountry,
      t001w.name1  as PlantName,
      t001w.ort01  as PlantCity,
      t001w.land1  as PlantCountry,
      t001w.regio  as PlantRegion,
      tka02.kokrs  as ControllingArea,
      cskt.ktext   as CostCenterName,
      cskt.ltext   as CostCenterDescription,
      cepct.ktext  as ProfitCenterName,
      cepct.ltext  as ProfitCenterDescription,
      

      // ---- Product ----
      B.Material,
      makt.maktx    as MaterialName,                    // MAKT-MAKTX
      B.MaterialGroup,
      B.ProductHierarchy,
      t179t.vtext   as ProductHierarchyText,            // T179T-VTEXT
      cast( substring( B.ProductHierarchy, 1, 5 )  as abap.char(5) )  as ProductHierarchyLevel1,
      cast( substring( B.ProductHierarchy, 1, 10 ) as abap.char(10) ) as ProductHierarchyLevel2,
      B.ItemCategory,
      mara.mtart    as MaterialType,                    // MTART
      cast( mara.ntgew as abap.dec(13,3) ) as NetWeightPerUnit,   // NTGEW (per base unit)
      mara.gewei    as WeightUnit,                      // GEWEI
      cast( mbew.stprs as abap.dec(17,2) ) as StandardPrice,      // STPRS (per PEINH)
      mbew.peinh    as StandardPriceUnit,               // PEINH
      mbew.vprsv    as PriceControl,                    // VPRSV (S = standard, V = moving avg)

      // ---- References ----
      B.SalesOrder,
      B.SalesOrderItem,
      B.ReferenceDelivery,

      // ---- Measures: document currency (signed) ----
      B.TransactionCurrency,
      B.SalesUnit,
      cast( B.BilledQuantity * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(15,3) )                          as BilledQuantity,
      cast( cast( B.NetAmount   as abap.dec(17,2) ) * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) )   as NetRevenue,
      cast( cast( B.CostAmount  as abap.dec(17,2) ) * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) )   as CostOfSales,
      cast( cast( B.GrossAmount as abap.dec(17,2) ) * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) )   as GrossRevenue,
      cast( cast( B.TaxAmount   as abap.dec(17,2) ) * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) )   as TaxAmount,
      cast( ( cast( B.GrossAmount as abap.dec(17,2) ) - cast( B.NetAmount  as abap.dec(17,2) ) )
            * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) )                                           as DiscountAmount,
      cast( ( cast( B.NetAmount   as abap.dec(17,2) ) - cast( B.CostAmount as abap.dec(17,2) ) )
            * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) )                                           as GrossMargin,

      // ---- Measures: company code currency (signed) ----
      B.CompanyCodeCurrency,
      cast( cast( B.NetAmountInCCCrcy   as abap.dec(17,2) ) * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) ) as NetRevenueInCCCrcy,
      cast( cast( B.CostAmountInCCCrcy  as abap.dec(17,2) ) * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) ) as CostOfSalesInCCCrcy,
      cast( cast( B.GrossAmountInCCCrcy as abap.dec(17,2) ) * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) ) as GrossRevenueInCCCrcy,
      cast( ( cast( B.NetAmountInCCCrcy as abap.dec(17,2) ) - cast( B.CostAmountInCCCrcy as abap.dec(17,2) ) )
            * B.SignFactor as abap.dec(17,2) )                                                 as GrossMarginInCCCrcy,

      // ---- Item-level % (row level only - recompute from sums in SAC) ----
      cast( case when B.NetAmount <> 0
                 then division( ( cast( B.NetAmount as abap.dec(17,2) ) - cast( B.CostAmount as abap.dec(17,2) ) ) * 100,
                                cast( B.NetAmount as abap.dec(17,2) ), 2 )
                 else cast( 0 as abap.dec(9,2) ) end as abap.dec(9,2) )                   as GrossMarginPercent,

      1 as BillingItemCount
}

sqlDdl:
@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZIYTDAGG'
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'YTD Aggregation CDS'
 
define view ZI_YTD_AGG
with parameters
 
    p_cy    : abap.char(4),
    p_cy1   : abap.char(4),
    p_cy2   : abap.char(4)
 
as select from ZI_YTD_CALC(
        p_cy  : :p_cy,
        p_cy1 : :p_cy1,
        p_cy2 : :p_cy2
    )
{
 
    vkorg as salesorg,
    waerk  as currency,
 
 
    /* Current Year YTD */
    sum(
        case
            when CY_FLAG = 'X'
            then netwr
            else 0
        end
    ) as CY_YTD,
 
 
    /* Previous Year YTD */
    sum(
        case
            when CY1_FLAG = 'X'
            then netwr
            else 0
        end
    ) as CY1_YTD,
 
 
    /* Previous 2 Year YTD */
    sum(
        case
            when CY2_FLAG = 'X'
            then netwr
            else 0
        end
    ) as CY2_YTD,
/* Previous Year Full Year */
sum(
    case
        when fiscal_year = :p_cy1
        then netwr
        else 0
    end
) as CY1_FULL_YEAR,
 
 
/* Previous 2 Year Full Year */
sum(
    case
        when fiscal_year = :p_cy2
        then netwr
        else 0
    end
) as CY2_FULL_YEAR
     
 
}
group by
    vkorg,
    waerk

define view ZI_YTD_CALC
with parameters
 
    p_cy    : abap.char(4),
    p_cy1   : abap.char(4),
    p_cy2   : abap.char(4)
 
as select from ZI_YTD_BASE
{
 
    key vbeln,
 
    vkorg,
    waerk,
    netwr,
    fiscal_year,
 
    case
        when fiscal_year = :p_cy
       and month_day <= current_month_day
        then 'X'
        else ''
    end as CY_FLAG,
 
 
    case
        when fiscal_year = :p_cy1
        and month_day <= current_month_day
        then 'X'
        else ''
    end as CY1_FLAG,
 
 
    case
        when fiscal_year = :p_cy2
         and month_day <= current_month_day
        then 'X'
        else ''
    end as CY2_FLAG
 
}

    sizeCategory: #S,
    dataClass: #MIXED

define view entity ZMDXCNAUTH01
  as select from    ZMDXCNAPPR01   as AP
    left outer join zmdxcnaprcls01 as APCL on AP.ApproverClassLineid = APCL.ApproverClassLineid
    left outer join ZMDXCNPOLICY01 as PL   on AP.ApproverClassLineid = PL.ApproverClassLineid
{
  key AP.ApproverLineid                                                  as ApproverLineId,
  key AP.ApproverClassLineid                                             as ApproverClassLineId,
      APCL.Systemname                                                    as SystemName,
      APCL.Hierarchy                                                     as Hierarchy,
      APCL.Subclass                                                      as SubClass,
      APCL.Userorgroup                                                   as UserOrGroup,
      AP.NodeName                                                        as NodeName,
      AP.ApproverId                                                      as ApproverId,
      AP.ApproverValidityStartDate                                       as ApproverValidityStartDate,
      AP.ApproverValidityEndDate                                         as ApproverValidityEndDate,
      AP.Ud1                                                             as AmountFrom,
      AP.Ud2                                                             as AmountTo,
      AP.Attestation                                                     as Attestation,
      AP.Status                                                          as Status,
      case when APCL.Userorgroup = 'U' then PL.Apprconstraint else 0 end as ApprConstraint,
      case when APCL.Userorgroup = 'U' then PL.Apprlevel else 0 end      as ApprLevel,
      case when APCL.Userorgroup = 'U' then PL.SapRole else '' end       as SAPRole,
      AP.UpdatedOn                                                       as UpdatedOn,
      AP.UpdatedBy                                                       as UpdatedBy,
      APCL.Classtype                                                     as ClassType

}
where
       AP.VersionActive           = 'Y'
  and(
       AP.Status                  = '510'
    or AP.Status                  = '110'

  and  AP.ApproverValidityEndDate >= $session.system_date

@EndUserText.label: 'Stock Report CDS'
define view ZMM_CDS_STOCK_REPORT
as select from ZMM_CDS_STOCK as stock

left outer join ZMM_CDS_ORDER_QTY as ord
on stock.matnr = ord.matnr
and stock.werks = ord.werks

left outer join ZMM_CDS_MATERIAL as makt
on stock.matnr = makt.matnr

left outer join ZMM_CDS_SALES as sales
on stock.matnr = sales.matnr

{
    key stock.matnr,
    key stock.werks,

    makt.maktx,

    sales.mvgr1,
    sales.mvgr2,
    sales.mvgr3,
    sales.mvgr4,
    sales.mvgr5,

    stock.total_stock,

    ord.order_qty,

    ( stock.total_stock - coalesce(ord.order_qty,0) ) as open_qty
}

CREATE VIEW "CJOURNALENTRYITM" AS SELECT
            acdoca.RCLNT AS Client,
            acdoca.RLDNR AS Ledger,
            acdoca.RBUKRS AS CompanyCode,
            acdoca.GJAHR AS FiscalYear,
            acdoca.BELNR AS AccountingDocument,
            acdoca.DOCLN AS LedgerGLLineItem,
            acdoca.RACCT AS GLAccount,
            acdoca.PRCTR AS ProfitCenter,
            acdoca.RCNTR AS CostCenter,
            acdoca.SEGMENT AS Segment,
            acdoca.WSL AS AmountInTransactionCurrency,
            acdoca.RWCUR AS TransactionCurrency,
            acdoca.HSL AS AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency,
            acdoca.RHCUR AS CompanyCodeCurrency,
            bkpf.BLDAT AS DocumentDate,
            bkpf.BUDAT AS PostingDate,
            bkpf.BLART AS AccountingDocumentType,
            bkpf.USNAM AS UserPostingDocument
        FROM "ACDOCA" acdoca
        INNER JOIN "BKPF" bkpf ON acdoca.RCLNT = bkpf.MANDT AND acdoca.RBUKRS = bkpf.BUKRS AND acdoca.BELNR = bkpf.BELNR AND acdoca.GJAHR = bkpf.GJAHR

name: I_BillingDocumentItem
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "IBILLINGDOCITM" AS SELECT
            vbrp.MANDT AS Client,
            vbrp.VBELN AS BillingDocument,
            vbrp.POSNR AS BillingDocumentItem,
            vbrp.FKIMG AS BilledQuantity,
            vbrp.VRKME AS BillingQuantityUnit,
            vbrp.NETWR AS NetAmount,
            vbrp.MATNR AS Product,
            vbrk.FKART AS BillingDocumentType,
            vbrk.FKDAT AS BillingDocumentDate,
            vbrk.KUNAG AS SoldToParty,
            vbrk.KUNRG AS PayerParty,
            vbrk.WAERK AS DocumentCurrency
        FROM "VBRP" vbrp
        INNER JOIN "VBRK" vbrk ON vbrp.MANDT = vbrk.MANDT AND vbrp.VBELN = vbrk.VBELN

name: I_CustomerPayment
description: Customer Accounts Receivable Open and Cleared Items
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "ICUSTPAYMENT" AS SELECT
            bsid.MANDT AS Client,
            bsid.BUKRS AS CompanyCode,
            bsid.KUNNR AS Customer,
            bsid.BELNR AS AccountingDocument,
            bsid.GJAHR AS FiscalYear,
            bsid.BUZEI AS LineItem,
            bsid.WRBTR AS AmountInTransactionCurrency,
            bsid.WAERS AS Currency,
            bsid.ZFBDT AS BaselineDate
        FROM "BSID" bsid

name: I_DeliveryDocumentItem
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "IDELIVDOCITM" AS SELECT
            lips.MANDT AS Client,
            lips.VBELN AS DeliveryDocument,
            lips.POSNR AS DeliveryDocumentItem,
            lips.MATNR AS Material,
            lips.LFIMG AS ActualDeliveryQuantity,
            lips.MEINS AS BaseUnit,
            lips.WERKS AS Plant,
            likp.LFART AS DeliveryDocumentType,
            likp.WADAT_IST AS ActualGoodsMovementDate,
            likp.KUNNR AS ShipToParty
        FROM "LIPS" lips
        INNER JOIN "LIKP" likp ON lips.MANDT = likp.MANDT AND lips.VBELN = likp.VBELN

name: I_MaterialStock
description: Current Material Stock per Plant & Storage Location
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "IMATERIALSTOCK" AS SELECT
            mard.MANDT AS Client,
            mard.MATNR AS Material,
            mard.WERKS AS Plant,
            mard.LGORT AS StorageLocation,
            mard.LABST AS UnrestrictedStock,
            mard.INSME AS StockInQualityInspection,
            mard.SPEME AS BlockedStock,
            mara.MTART AS MaterialType,
            mara.MEINS AS BaseUnitOfMeasure
        FROM "MARD" mard
        INNER JOIN "MARA" mara ON mard.MANDT = mara.MANDT AND mard.MATNR = mara.MATNR

name: I_ProductionOrderItem
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "IPRODORDERITM" AS SELECT
            afpo.MANDT AS Client,
            afpo.AUFNR AS ProductionOrder,
            afpo.POSNR AS OrderItem,
            afpo.MATNR AS Product,
            afpo.PSMNG AS TargetQuantity,
            afpo.WEMNG AS ConfirmedDeliveredQuantity,
            afko.GLTRP AS ScheduledEndDate,
            afko.GSTRP AS ScheduledStartDate
        FROM "AFPO" afpo
        INNER JOIN "AFKO" afko ON afpo.MANDT = afko.MANDT AND afpo.AUFNR = afko.AUFNR

name: I_ProductMaster
sqlDdl:
CREATE VIEW "IPRODUCTMASTER" AS SELECT
            mara.MANDT AS Client,
            mara.MATNR AS Product,
            mara.MTART AS ProductType,
            mara.MATKL AS ProductGroup,
            mara.MEINS AS BaseUnit,
            makt.SPRAS AS Language,
            makt.MAKTX AS ProductDescription
        FROM "MARA" mara
        LEFT OUTER JOIN "MAKT" makt ON mara.MANDT = makt.MANDT AND mara.MATNR = makt.MATNR
